1→/**
     2→ * Type guard for plain objects.
     3→ * @internal Used by deepMerge.
     4→ */
     5→function isPlainObject(item: unknown): item is Record<string, unknown> {
     6→  return item !== null && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item);
     7→}
     8→
     9→/**
    10→ * Sanitize settings by removing undefined values recursively
    11→ */
    12→export function sanitizeSettings<T>(obj: T): T {
    13→  if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
    14→  if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(sanitizeSettings) as T;
    15→  const cleaned: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    16→  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj as Record<string, unknown>)) {
    17→    if (v === undefined) continue;
    18→    cleaned[k] = sanitizeSettings(v);
    19→  }
    20→  return cleaned as T;
    21→}
    22→
    23→/**
    24→ * Deep equality check for settings objects
    25→ */
    26→export function deepEqual(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
    27→  try {
    28→    return JSON.stringify(sanitizeSettings(a)) === JSON.stringify(sanitizeSettings(b));
    29→  } catch {
    30→    // JSON.stringify can throw on circular references or other edge cases
    31→    return false;
    32→  }
    33→}
    34→
    35→/**
    36→ * Deep merge objects. Returns a new object with source properties merged into target.
    37→ * Arrays are replaced entirely (deep cloned), objects are merged recursively.
    38→ */
    39→export function deepMerge<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
    40→  target: T,
    41→  ...sources: Array<Partial<T> | undefined | null>
    42→): T {
    43→  if (!sources.length) return target;
    44→  const source = sources.shift();
    45→
    46→  if (!source) return deepMerge(target, ...sources);
    47→  if (!target) return deepMerge(source as T, ...sources);
    48→
    49→  const output = { ...target } as Record<string, unknown>;
    50→
    51→  Object.keys(source).forEach(key => {
    52→    const sourceValue = (source as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
    53→    if (sourceValue === undefined) return;
    54→
    55→    // Special handling for arrays - always deep clone to prevent reference sharing
    56→    if (Array.isArray(sourceValue)) {
    57→      // For arrays, we replace entirely but deep clone to prevent mutations
    58→      output[key] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sourceValue));
    59→    } else if (isPlainObject(sourceValue)) {
    60→      // For objects (but not arrays), merge recursively
    61→      output[key] = deepMerge(
    62→        (output[key] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {},
    63→        sourceValue as Record<string, unknown>
    64→      );
    65→    } else {
    66→      // For primitives, just assign the value
    67→      output[key] = sourceValue;
    68→    }
    69→  });
    70→
    71→  return deepMerge(output as T, ...sources);
    72→}
    73→

1→/**
     2→ * Shared utilities for resolving tool settings across different scopes.
     3→ * 
     4→ * IMPORTANT: This is the single source of truth for settings priority.
     5→ * If you need to change the priority order, update it here and all consumers
     6→ * will automatically get the update.
     7→ * 
     8→ * Priority order (highest to lowest): shot → project → user → defaults
     9→ */
    10→
    11→type GenerationModeRaw = 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair' | undefined;
    12→export type GenerationModeNormalized = 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair';
    13→
    14→/**
    15→ * Normalize generation mode: preserves all three values, defaults undefined to 'timeline'.
    16→ */
    17→function normalizeGenerationMode(mode: GenerationModeRaw): GenerationModeNormalized {
    18→  if (mode === 'batch' || mode === 'by-pair' || mode === 'timeline') return mode;
    19→  return 'timeline';
    20→}
    21→
    22→/**
    23→ * Settings sources for resolution.
    24→ * Each source should contain tool-specific settings (already extracted from the parent object).
    25→ */
    26→interface SettingsSources {
    27→  defaults?: Record<string, unknown>;
    28→  user?: Record<string, unknown>;
    29→  project?: Record<string, unknown>;
    30→  shot?: Record<string, unknown>;
    31→}
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Resolve a single settings field using standard priority.
    35→ * Priority: shot → project → user → defaults
    36→ * 
    37→ * @param field - The field name to resolve
    38→ * @param sources - Settings from each scope (should be tool-specific settings)
    39→ * @returns The resolved value, or undefined if not found in any source
    40→ */
    41→function resolveSettingField<T>(
    42→  field: string,
    43→  sources: SettingsSources
    44→): T | undefined {
    45→  // Priority order: shot → project → user → defaults
    46→  // Use explicit undefined checks because null/false/0 are valid values
    47→  if (sources.shot?.[field] !== undefined) return sources.shot[field];
    48→  if (sources.project?.[field] !== undefined) return sources.project[field];
    49→  if (sources.user?.[field] !== undefined) return sources.user[field];
    50→  if (sources.defaults?.[field] !== undefined) return sources.defaults[field];
    51→  return undefined;
    52→}
    53→
    54→/**
    55→ * Resolve generation mode using standard priority and normalization.
    56→ * This is a convenience wrapper for the common case of resolving generationMode.
    57→ * 
    58→ * @param sources - Settings from each scope (should be tool-specific settings)
    59→ * @returns Normalized generation mode ('batch', 'timeline', or 'by-pair')
    60→ */
    61→export function resolveGenerationMode(sources: SettingsSources): GenerationModeNormalized {
    62→  const raw = resolveSettingField<GenerationModeRaw>('generationMode', sources);
    63→  return normalizeGenerationMode(raw);
    64→}
    65→
    66→/**
    67→ * Extract tool-specific settings from a full settings object.
    68→ * Handles the common pattern of settings being nested under tool ID.
    69→ * 
    70→ * @param settings - Full settings object (e.g., from DB)
    71→ * @param toolId - Tool identifier
    72→ * @returns Tool-specific settings or empty object
    73→ */
    74→export function extractToolSettings(
    75→  settings: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
    76→  toolId: string
    77→): Record<string, unknown> {
    78→  return (settings?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
    79→}

1→/**
     2→ * useLoadVariantImages Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Loads a variant's source images onto the timeline by switching primary variants.
     5→ * For each image position (start, end) where the image differs:
     6→ * - Same generation, different variant → find and set as primary
     7→ * - Same generation, match by URL → find and set as primary
     8→ * - Different generation entirely → create new variant with source URL, set as primary
     9→ */
    10→
    11→import { useCallback, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
    12→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    13→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    14→import { invalidateVariantChange } from '@/shared/hooks/useGenerationInvalidation';
    15→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    16→import type { GenerationVariant } from '@/shared/hooks/useVariants';
    17→import type { CurrentSegmentImagesData } from '@/shared/components/VariantSelector/utils';
    18→
    19→interface UseLoadVariantImagesProps {
    20→  currentSegmentImages?: CurrentSegmentImagesData & {
    21→    startShotGenerationId?: string;
    22→    endShotGenerationId?: string;
    23→  };
    24→}
    25→
    26→/**
    27→ * Extract the storage path from a full URL or relative path for matching.
    28→ */
    29→function extractStoragePath(url: string | undefined | null): string | null {
    30→  if (!url) return null;
    31→  const storageMatch = url.match(/\/storage\/v1\/object\/(?:public|sign)\/(.+?)(?:\?|$)/);
    32→  if (storageMatch) return storageMatch[1];
    33→  if (url.startsWith('generations/') || url.startsWith('/generations/')) {
    34→    return url.replace(/^\//, '');
    35→  }
    36→  return url;
    37→}
    38→
    39→function pathsMatch(url1: string | undefined | null, url2: string | undefined | null): boolean {
    40→  if (!url1 || !url2) return false;
    41→  if (url1 === url2) return true;
    42→  const p1 = extractStoragePath(url1);
    43→  const p2 = extractStoragePath(url2);
    44→  return !!p1 && !!p2 && p1 === p2;
    45→}
    46→
    47→export function useLoadVariantImages({ currentSegmentImages }: UseLoadVariantImagesProps) {
    48→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    49→  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
    50→
    51→  // Clean up on unmount
    52→  useEffect(() => {
    53→    return () => {
    54→      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    55→    };
    56→  }, []);
    57→
    58→  const loadVariantImages = useCallback(async (variant: GenerationVariant) => {
    59→    // Abort any previous in-flight request
    60→    abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    61→    abortControllerRef.current = new AbortController();
    62→    const signal = abortControllerRef.current.signal;
    63→
    64→    if (!currentSegmentImages) return;
    65→
    66→    const params = variant.params;
    67→    if (!params) return;
    68→
    69→    // Extract source image data from variant params
    70→    const indivParams = (params.individual_segment_params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    71→    const resolvedPaths = (indivParams.input_image_paths_resolved || params.input_image_paths_resolved) as string[] | undefined;
    72→
    73→    const variantStartGenId = (indivParams.start_image_generation_id || params.start_image_generation_id) as string | undefined;
    74→    const variantEndGenId = (indivParams.end_image_generation_id || params.end_image_generation_id) as string | undefined;
    75→    const variantStartVariantId = (indivParams.start_image_variant_id || params.start_image_variant_id) as string | undefined;
    76→    const variantEndVariantId = (indivParams.end_image_variant_id || params.end_image_variant_id) as string | undefined;
    77→    const variantStartUrl = resolvedPaths?.[0] || (indivParams.start_image_url || params.start_image_url) as string | undefined;
    78→    const variantEndUrl = resolvedPaths && resolvedPaths.length > 1
    79→      ? resolvedPaths[resolvedPaths.length - 1]
    80→      : (indivParams.end_image_url || params.end_image_url) as string | undefined;
    81→
    82→    // Process each image position
    83→    const positions = [
    84→      {
    85→        variantGenId: variantStartGenId,
    86→        variantVariantId: variantStartVariantId,
    87→        variantUrl: variantStartUrl,
    88→        currentGenId: currentSegmentImages.startGenerationId,
    89→        currentVariantId: currentSegmentImages.startVariantId,
    90→        currentUrl: currentSegmentImages.startUrl,
    91→      },
    92→      {
    93→        variantGenId: variantEndGenId,
    94→        variantVariantId: variantEndVariantId,
    95→        variantUrl: variantEndUrl,
    96→        currentGenId: currentSegmentImages.endGenerationId,
    97→        currentVariantId: currentSegmentImages.endVariantId,
    98→        currentUrl: currentSegmentImages.endUrl,
    99→      },
   100→    ];
   101→
   102→    for (const pos of positions) {
   103→      // Skip if no source data or no current data
   104→      if (!pos.variantGenId && !pos.variantUrl) continue;
   105→      if (!pos.currentGenId) continue;
   106→
   107→      // Check if this request was superseded before each async operation
   108→      if (signal.aborted) return;
   109→
   110→      try {
   111→        await loadSingleImage({
   112→          variantGenId: pos.variantGenId,
   113→          variantVariantId: pos.variantVariantId,
   114→          variantUrl: pos.variantUrl,
   115→          currentGenId: pos.currentGenId,
   116→          currentVariantId: pos.currentVariantId,
   117→          currentUrl: pos.currentUrl,
   118→        });
   119→
   120→        if (signal.aborted) return;
   121→
   122→        // Invalidate caches for this generation
   123→        await invalidateVariantChange(queryClient, {
   124→          generationId: pos.currentGenId,
   125→          reason: 'load-variant-images',
   126→        });
   127→
   128→        if (signal.aborted) return;
   129→      } catch (error) {
   130→        if (signal.aborted) return;
   131→        handleError(error, { context: 'LoadVariantImages', showToast: false });
   132→      }
   133→    }
   134→  }, [currentSegmentImages, queryClient]);
   135→
   136→  return { loadVariantImages };
   137→}
   138→
   139→/**
   140→ * Load a single image position: find or create the variant and make it primary.
   141→ */
   142→async function loadSingleImage(pos: {
   143→  variantGenId: string | undefined;
   144→  variantVariantId: string | undefined;
   145→  variantUrl: string | undefined;
   146→  currentGenId: string;
   147→  currentVariantId: string | undefined;
   148→  currentUrl: string | undefined;
   149→}) {
   150→  // Check if images actually differ
   151→  if (pos.variantGenId === pos.currentGenId) {
   152→    if (pos.variantVariantId && pos.currentVariantId && pos.variantVariantId === pos.currentVariantId) {
   153→      return; // Same variant, nothing to do
   154→    }
   155→    if (!pos.variantVariantId && !pos.currentVariantId) {
   156→      if (pathsMatch(pos.variantUrl, pos.currentUrl)) return;
   157→    }
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  const targetGenerationId = pos.currentGenId;
   161→
   162→  // Strategy 1: Same generation - find variant by ID
   163→  if (pos.variantGenId === pos.currentGenId && pos.variantVariantId) {
   164→    await setPrimaryById(pos.variantVariantId);
   165→    return;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // Strategy 2: Find variant by URL match on the current generation
   169→  if (pos.variantUrl) {
   170→    const { data: existingVariants } = await supabase
   171→      .from('generation_variants')
   172→      .select('id, location')
   173→      .eq('generation_id', targetGenerationId);
   174→
   175→    if (existingVariants) {
   176→      const match = existingVariants.find(v => pathsMatch(v.location, pos.variantUrl));
   177→      if (match) {
   178→        await setPrimaryById(match.id);
   179→        return;
   180→      }
   181→    }
   182→
   183→    // Strategy 3: Create new variant with the source URL
   184→    const { error } = await supabase
   185→      .from('generation_variants')
   186→      .insert({
   187→        generation_id: targetGenerationId,
   188→        location: pos.variantUrl,
   189→        thumbnail_url: pos.variantUrl,
   190→        is_primary: true, // DB trigger handles unsetting old primary
   191→        variant_type: 'loaded',
   192→        params: {
   193→          source_generation_id: pos.variantGenId,
   194→          loaded_from_variant: pos.variantVariantId,
   195→          source_url: pos.variantUrl,
   196→        },
   197→      })
   198→      .select('id')
   199→      .single();
   200→
   201→    if (error) {
   202→      throw new Error(`Failed to create variant: ${error.message}`);
   203→    }
   204→  }
   205→}
   206→
   207→/**
   208→ * Set a variant as primary by ID. DB trigger handles unsetting the old primary.
   209→ */
   210→async function setPrimaryById(variantId: string) {
   211→  const { error } = await supabase
   212→    .from('generation_variants')
   213→    .update({ is_primary: true })
   214→    .eq('id', variantId);
   215→
   216→  if (error) {
   217→    throw new Error(`Failed to set primary variant: ${error.message}`);
   218→  }
   219→}
   220→

1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    11→ *
    12→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    13→ */
    14→
    15→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    16→
    17→export interface QueuedWrite {
    18→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    19→  entityId: string;
    20→  toolId: string;
    21→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    22→}
    23→
    24→interface PendingWrite {
    25→  write: QueuedWrite;
    26→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    27→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    28→  enqueuedAt: number;
    29→}
    30→
    31→// Configuration
    32→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    33→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    34→
    35→// State
    36→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    37→let inFlightCount = 0;
    38→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    39→
    40→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    41→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Set the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    45→ * Must be called once at app init (in useToolSettings.ts).
    46→ */
    47→export function setSettingsWriteFunction(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    48→  writeFunction = fn;
    49→}
    50→
    51→/**
    52→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
    53→ */
    54→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
    55→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
    56→}
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Deep merge two objects (shallow merge of nested objects)
    60→ */
    61→function mergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    62→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
    63→}
    64→
    65→/**
    66→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
    67→ */
    68→async function processQueue() {
    69→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
    70→    return;
    71→  }
    72→
    73→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
    74→  if (!next) return;
    75→
    76→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
    77→  
    78→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
    79→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
    80→  
    81→  inFlightCount++;
    82→  
    83→  try {
    84→    if (!writeFunction) {
    85→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
    86→    }
    87→    
    88→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
    89→    
    90→    // Resolve all waiters
    91→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
    92→      resolve(result);
    93→    }
    94→  } catch (error) {
    95→    handleError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
    96→
    97→    // Reject all waiters
    98→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
    99→      reject(error);
   100→    }
   101→  } finally {
   102→    inFlightCount--;
   103→    
   104→    // Process next item
   105→    processQueue();
   106→  }
   107→}
   108→
   109→/**
   110→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   111→ */
   112→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   113→  // Clear existing timer
   114→  if (pending.timerId) {
   115→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   116→    pending.timerId = null;
   117→  }
   118→  
   119→  // Add to flush queue and process
   120→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   121→  processQueue();
   122→}
   123→
   124→/**
   125→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   126→ * 
   127→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   128→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   129→ * 
   130→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   131→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   132→ */
   133→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   134→  write: QueuedWrite,
   135→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   136→): Promise<unknown> {
   137→  const key = targetKey(write);
   138→  
   139→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   140→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   141→    
   142→    if (existing) {
   143→      // Merge with existing pending write
   144→      existing.write.patch = mergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   145→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   146→
   147→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   148→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   149→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   150→      }
   151→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   152→      
   153→    } else {
   154→      // Create new pending write
   155→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   156→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   157→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   158→        timerId: null,
   159→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   160→      };
   161→
   162→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   163→
   164→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   165→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   166→      } else {
   167→        // Set debounce timer
   168→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   169→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   170→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   171→      }
   172→    }
   173→  });
   174→}
   175→
   176→
   177→/**
   178→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   179→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   180→ */
   181→function flushAll(): void {
   182→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   183→    if (pending.timerId) {
   184→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   185→      pending.timerId = null;
   186→    }
   187→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   188→  }
   189→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   190→  processQueue();
   191→}
   192→
   193→// Best-effort flush on page unload and tab hide
   194→// Mobile browsers don't reliably fire beforeunload (e.g., tab switching on iOS Safari),
   195→// so we also flush on visibilitychange to prevent losing pending writes.
   196→if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   197→  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
   198→    flushAll();
   199→  });
   200→
   201→  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
   202→    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
   203→      flushAll();
   204→    }
   205→  });
   206→}

1→import React from 'react';

     4→
     5→interface ToolErrorBoundaryState {
     6→  hasError: boolean;
     7→  error: Error | null;
     8→  errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo | null;
     9→}
    10→
    11→interface ToolErrorBoundaryProps {
    12→  toolName: string;
    13→  children: React.ReactNode;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Per-tool error boundary that catches errors within a single tool's route
    18→ * and displays a recovery UI instead of crashing the entire app.
    19→ *
    20→ * Wrap each tool's page element in routes.tsx so that one tool's crash
    21→ * doesn't take down unrelated UI (header, panes, other tools).
    22→ */
    23→export class ToolErrorBoundary extends React.Component<
    24→  ToolErrorBoundaryProps,
    25→  ToolErrorBoundaryState
    26→> {
    27→  constructor(props: ToolErrorBoundaryProps) {
    28→    super(props);
    29→    this.state = {
    30→      hasError: false,
    31→      error: null,
    32→      errorInfo: null,
    33→    };
    34→  }
    35→
    36→  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): Partial<ToolErrorBoundaryState> {
    37→    return { hasError: true, error };
    38→  }
    39→
    40→  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo): void {
    41→    console.error(`[ToolErrorBoundary:${this.props.toolName}] Uncaught error:`, {
    42→      message: error.message,
    43→      name: error.name,
    44→      stack: error.stack?.split('\n').slice(0, 5).join('\n'),
    45→      componentStack: errorInfo.componentStack?.split('\n').slice(0, 10).join('\n'),
    46→    });
    47→
    48→    this.setState({ errorInfo });
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  handleRetry = (): void => {
    52→    this.setState({
    53→      hasError: false,
    54→      error: null,
    55→      errorInfo: null,
    56→    });
    57→  };
    58→
    59→  render(): React.ReactNode {
    60→    if (this.state.hasError) {
    61→      const { error } = this.state;
    62→      const { toolName } = this.props;
    63→      const isDev = import.meta.env.DEV;
    64→
    65→      return (
    66→        <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-8 min-h-[50vh]">
    67→          <div className="max-w-md w-full space-y-6 text-center">
    68→            <div className="flex justify-center">
    69→              <div className="rounded-full bg-destructive/10 p-3">
    70→                <AlertTriangle className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive" />
    71→              </div>
    72→            </div>
    73→
    74→            <div className="space-y-2">
    75→              <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-foreground">
    76→                {toolName} encountered an error
    77→              </h2>
    78→              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
    79→                Something went wrong in this tool. Your other tools and data are unaffected.
    80→              </p>
    81→            </div>
    82→
    83→            {isDev && error && (
    84→              <div className="bg-muted rounded-lg p-4 text-left">
    85→                <p className="text-sm font-mono text-destructive break-all">
    86→                  {error.name}: {error.message}
    87→                </p>
    88→                {error.stack && (
    89→                  <pre className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground overflow-x-auto max-h-32">
    90→                    {error.stack.split('\n').slice(1, 6).join('\n')}
    91→                  </pre>
    92→                )}
    93→              </div>
    94→            )}
    95→
    96→            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 justify-center">
    97→              <Button onClick={this.handleRetry} variant="default">
    98→                <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
    99→                Try Again
   100→              </Button>
   101→              <Button variant="outline" asChild>
   102→                <a href="/">
   103→                  <Home className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
   104→                  Go Home
   105→                </a>
   106→              </Button>
   107→            </div>
   108→          </div>
   109→        </div>
   110→      );
   111→    }
   112→
   113→    return this.props.children;
   114→  }
   115→}

1→import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';
     3→import { getImageRange } from '../utils/image-utils';
     4→import { SELECTION_BAR_DELAY } from '../constants';
     5→
     6→interface UseSelectionProps {
     7→  images: GenerationRow[];
     8→  isMobile: boolean;
     9→  generationMode: 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair';
    10→  onSelectionChange?: (hasSelection: boolean) => void;
    11→}
    12→
    13→export function useSelection({
    14→  images,
    15→  isMobile,
    16→  generationMode,
    17→  onSelectionChange
    18→}: UseSelectionProps) {
    19→  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    20→  const [mobileSelectedIds, setMobileSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    21→  const [lastSelectedIndex, setLastSelectedIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
    22→  const [showSelectionBar, setShowSelectionBar] = useState(false);
    23→  const [renderCounter, setRenderCounter] = useState(0);
    24→  
    25→  // Refs to always access latest state - fix for stale closure issues
    26→  const selectedIdsRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
    27→  const mobileSelectedIdsRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
    28→  
    29→  // Update refs synchronously during render
    30→  selectedIdsRef.current = selectedIds;
    31→  mobileSelectedIdsRef.current = mobileSelectedIds;
    32→  
    33→  // Show selection bar with a delay after items are selected
    34→  useEffect(() => {
    35→    const hasSelection = selectedIds.length > 0 || mobileSelectedIds.length > 0;
    36→    
    37→    if (hasSelection) {
    38→      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    39→        setShowSelectionBar(true);
    40→      }, SELECTION_BAR_DELAY);
    41→      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    42→    } else {
    43→      setShowSelectionBar(false);
    44→    }
    45→  }, [selectedIds.length, mobileSelectedIds.length]);
    46→  
    47→  // Dispatch selection state to hide pane controls on mobile
    48→  useEffect(() => {
    49→    if (isMobile) {
    50→      const hasSelection = mobileSelectedIds.length > 0;
    51→      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mobileSelectionActive', { detail: hasSelection }));
    52→    }
    53→    
    54→    // Cleanup: ensure pane controls are restored when component unmounts
    55→    return () => {
    56→      if (isMobile) {
    57→        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mobileSelectionActive', { detail: false }));
    58→      }
    59→    };
    60→  }, [mobileSelectedIds.length, isMobile]);
    61→  
    62→  // Wrap setSelectedIds to force re-render
    63→  const setSelectedIdsWithRerender = useCallback((newIds: string[] | ((prev: string[]) => string[])) => {
    64→    setSelectedIds(newIds);
    65→    setRenderCounter(prev => prev + 1);
    66→  }, []);
    67→  
    68→  // Clear selection
    69→  const clearSelection = useCallback(() => {
    70→    setSelectedIds([]);
    71→    setMobileSelectedIds([]);
    72→    setLastSelectedIndex(null);
    73→    onSelectionChange?.(false);
    74→  }, [selectedIds.length, mobileSelectedIds.length, onSelectionChange]);
    75→  
    76→  // Handle item click (desktop)
    77→  const handleItemClick = useCallback((imageKey: string, event: React.MouseEvent) => {
    78→    event.preventDefault();
    79→    
    80→    // Mobile behavior for batch mode
    81→    if (isMobile && generationMode !== 'timeline') {
    82→      const wasSelected = mobileSelectedIds.includes(imageKey);
    83→      
    84→      if (wasSelected) {
    85→        setMobileSelectedIds(prev => {
    86→          const newSelection = prev.filter(selectedId => selectedId !== imageKey);
    87→          onSelectionChange?.(newSelection.length > 0);
    88→          return newSelection;
    89→        });
    90→      } else {
    91→        setMobileSelectedIds(prev => {
    92→          const newSelection = [...prev, imageKey];
    93→          onSelectionChange?.(true);
    94→          return newSelection;
    95→        });
    96→      }
    97→      return;
    98→    }
    99→    
   100→    // Find the current image index
   101→    // img.id is shot_generations.id - unique per entry
   102→    const currentIndex = images.findIndex(img => img.id === imageKey);
   103→    
   104→    // Desktop behavior
   105→    if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) {
   106→      // Command+click behavior
   107→      const isCurrentlySelected = selectedIds.includes(imageKey);
   108→      
   109→      if (lastSelectedIndex !== null && lastSelectedIndex !== currentIndex && selectedIds.length > 0) {
   110→        // Range operation: select or deselect range between lastSelectedIndex and currentIndex
   111→        const rangeIds = getImageRange(lastSelectedIndex, currentIndex, images);
   112→        
   113→        if (isCurrentlySelected) {
   114→          // Deselect range
   115→          setSelectedIds((prev) => {
   116→            const newSelection = prev.filter(selectedId => !rangeIds.includes(selectedId));
   117→            if (newSelection.length === 0) {
   118→              setLastSelectedIndex(null);
   119→            }
   120→            onSelectionChange?.(newSelection.length > 0);
   121→            return newSelection;
   122→          });
   123→        } else {
   124→          // Select range
   125→          setSelectedIdsWithRerender((prev) => {
   126→            const newSelection = Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...rangeIds]));
   127→            onSelectionChange?.(true);
   128→            return newSelection;
   129→          });
   130→          setLastSelectedIndex(currentIndex);
   131→        }
   132→      } else {
   133→        // Regular Ctrl/Cmd+click: Toggle individual selection
   134→        setSelectedIds((prev) => {
   135→          if (isCurrentlySelected) {
   136→            const newSelection = prev.filter((selectedId) => selectedId !== imageKey);
   137→            if (newSelection.length === 0) {
   138→              setLastSelectedIndex(null);
   139→            }
   140→            onSelectionChange?.(newSelection.length > 0);
   141→            return newSelection;
   142→          } else {
   143→            setLastSelectedIndex(currentIndex);
   144→            const newSelection = [...prev, imageKey];
   145→            onSelectionChange?.(true);
   146→            return newSelection;
   147→          }
   148→        });
   149→      }
   150→    } else {
   151→      // Single click: Toggle individual selection
   152→      setSelectedIdsWithRerender((prev) => {
   153→        const isSelected = prev.includes(imageKey);
   154→        if (isSelected) {
   155→          const newSelection = prev.filter((selectedId) => selectedId !== imageKey);
   156→          if (newSelection.length === 0) {
   157→            setLastSelectedIndex(null);
   158→          }
   159→          onSelectionChange?.(newSelection.length > 0);
   160→          return newSelection;
   161→        } else {
   162→          setLastSelectedIndex(currentIndex);
   163→          const newSelection = [...prev, imageKey];
   164→          onSelectionChange?.(true);
   165→          return newSelection;
   166→        }
   167→      });
   168→    }
   169→  }, [isMobile, generationMode, mobileSelectedIds, images, lastSelectedIndex, selectedIds, onSelectionChange, setSelectedIdsWithRerender]);
   170→  
   171→  return {
   172→    selectedIds,
   173→    setSelectedIds,
   174→    mobileSelectedIds,
   175→    setMobileSelectedIds,
   176→    lastSelectedIndex,
   177→    setLastSelectedIndex,
   178→    showSelectionBar,
   179→    renderCounter,
   180→    selectedIdsRef,
   181→    mobileSelectedIdsRef,
   182→    setSelectedIdsWithRerender,
   183→    clearSelection,
   184→    handleItemClick
   185→  };
   186→}
   187→
   188→

1→import { PhaseConfig } from '@/shared/types/phaseConfig';
     2→import type { PathLoraConfig } from '@/shared/types/lora';
     3→
     4→// ============================================================================
     5→// Video Generation API Param Interfaces (Single Source of Truth)
     6→// ============================================================================
     7→// These interfaces define the snake_case params sent to the backend.
     8→// UI code should re-export these types and use them when building task params.
     9→
    10→// ============================================================================
    11→// NEW UNIFIED STRUCTURE GUIDANCE FORMAT
    12→// ============================================================================
    13→
    14→/**
    15→ * Unified structure guidance configuration.
    16→ * This is the new format that combines VACE and Uni3C configuration into a single object.
    17→ *
    18→ * Example VACE with flow:
    19→ * ```
    20→ * {
    21→ *   target: "vace",
    22→ *   preprocessing: "flow",
    23→ *   strength: 1.2,
    24→ * }
    25→ * ```
    26→ *
    27→ * Example Uni3C:
    28→ * ```
    29→ * {
    30→ *   target: "uni3c",
    31→ *   strength: 0.8,
    32→ *   step_window: [0.1, 0.9],
    33→ * }
    34→ * ```
    35→ */
    36→export interface StructureGuidanceConfig {
    37→  /** Target system for guidance: "vace" for VACE model, "uni3c" for I2V with guidance */
    38→  target: 'vace' | 'uni3c';
    39→
    40→  /**
    41→   * Preprocessing method (VACE only):
    42→   * - "flow": optical flow extraction
    43→   * - "canny": edge detection
    44→   * - "depth": depth estimation
    45→   * - "none": use raw frames (equivalent to old "raw" structure_type)
    46→   */
    47→  preprocessing?: 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth' | 'none';
    48→
    49→  /** Unified strength parameter (works for both VACE and Uni3C). Default: 1.0 */
    50→  strength?: number;
    51→
    52→  /** VACE-specific: canny edge detection intensity. Default: 1.0 */
    53→  canny_intensity?: number;
    54→
    55→  /** VACE-specific: depth contrast. Default: 1.0 */
    56→  depth_contrast?: number;
    57→
    58→  /**
    59→   * Uni3C-specific: step window as [start_percent, end_percent].
    60→   * Controls when during inference uni3c guidance is applied.
    61→   * Default: [0.0, 1.0]
    62→   */
    63→  step_window?: [number, number];
    64→
    65→  /** Uni3C-specific: frame policy. Default: "fit" */
    66→  frame_policy?: 'fit' | 'clip';
    67→
    68→  /** Uni3C-specific: zero out empty frames. Default: true */
    69→  zero_empty_frames?: boolean;
    70→}
    71→
    72→// ============================================================================
    73→// LEGACY INTERFACES (kept for backward compatibility)
    74→// ============================================================================
    75→
    76→/**
    77→ * Structure video parameters for VACE mode (LEGACY - single video format).
    78→ * Controls how a reference video guides the motion/structure of generation.
    79→ * @deprecated Use `structure_guidance` + `structure_videos` array format instead.
    80→ */
    81→interface VideoStructureApiParams {
    82→  /** Path to structure video (S3/Storage URL) */
    83→  structure_video_path?: string | null;
    84→  /** How to handle frame count mismatches between structure video and generation */
    85→  structure_video_treatment?: 'adjust' | 'clip';
    86→  /** Motion strength: 0.0 = no motion, 1.0 = full motion, >1.0 = amplified */
    87→  structure_video_motion_strength?: number;
    88→  /** Type of structure extraction from video: uni3c (raw), optical flow, canny, or depth */
    89→  structure_video_type?: 'uni3c' | 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth';
    90→  /** Uni3C end percent (0-1, only used when structure_video_type is 'uni3c') */
    91→  uni3c_end_percent?: number;
    92→}
    93→
    94→/**
    95→ * Single structure video configuration within the structure_videos array.
    96→ * Defines which OUTPUT timeline frames this video guides and which SOURCE frames to use.
    97→ *
    98→ * NOTE: In the new unified format, structure_type and strength params moved to
    99→ * the separate `structure_guidance` config object. This now only contains
   100→ * the video source and frame mapping info.
   101→ *
   102→ * Frame ranges are half-open: start_frame inclusive, end_frame exclusive.
   103→ * Example: start_frame=0, end_frame=81 covers frames 0-80 (81 frames total).
   104→ */
   105→export interface StructureVideoConfig {
   106→  /** Path to structure video (S3/Storage URL) - REQUIRED */
   107→  path: string;

   319→    }
   320→  }, [shotId, shotGenerations, deleteItem]);
   321→
   322→  return {
   323→    handleReorder,
   324→    handleDelete,
   325→    isLoading,
   326→    // Provide batch-mode sorted images
   327→    getBatchImages: () => getImagesForMode('batch')

1→/**
     2→ * Hook for updating pair frame counts on the timeline.
     3→ * Handles the complex logic of shifting subsequent images and compression.
     4→ */
     5→
     6→import { useCallback, type RefObject } from 'react';
     7→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     8→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';
     9→
    10→interface UseFrameCountUpdaterProps {
    11→  /** Shot generations (images) */
    12→  shotGenerations: GenerationRow[];
    13→  /** Current generation mode */
    14→  generationMode: 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair';
    15→  /** Maximum frame limit for a single pair */
    16→  maxFrameLimit: number;
    17→  /** Reload positions after update */
    18→  loadPositions: (options?: { silent?: boolean; reason?: string }) => Promise<void>;
    19→  /**
    20→   * Ref to a function that updates trailing end frame through the position system.
    21→   * When set, trailing segment changes get instant optimistic updates on the timeline.
    22→   * When null/undefined, falls back to direct DB write + loadPositions (slower round-trip).
    23→   */
    24→  trailingFrameUpdateRef?: RefObject<((endFrame: number) => void) | null>;
    25→}
    26→
    27→interface UseFrameCountUpdaterReturn {
    28→  /** Update the frame count for a pair, shifting subsequent images as needed */
    29→  updatePairFrameCount: (pairShotGenerationId: string, newFrameCount: number) => Promise<{ finalFrameCount: number } | void>;
    30→}
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Provides a function to update the frame count for a pair.
    34→ *
    35→ * For pairs with an end image: shifts subsequent images forward.
    36→ * For trailing segments (no end image): updates metadata.end_frame on the start image.
    37→ *
    38→ * When exceeding maxFrameLimit, compresses subsequent pairs proportionally.
    39→ */
    40→export function useFrameCountUpdater({
    41→  shotGenerations,
    42→  generationMode,
    43→  maxFrameLimit,
    44→  loadPositions,
    45→  trailingFrameUpdateRef,
    46→}: UseFrameCountUpdaterProps): UseFrameCountUpdaterReturn {
    47→  const updatePairFrameCount = useCallback(async (
    48→    pairShotGenerationId: string,
    49→    newFrameCount: number
    50→  ) => {
    51→    // Only works in timeline mode
    52→    if (!shotGenerations?.length || generationMode !== 'timeline') {
    53→      return;
    54→    }
    55→
    56→    // Sort images by frame position
    57→    const sortedImages = [...shotGenerations]
    58→      .filter((img) => img.timeline_frame != null && img.timeline_frame >= 0)
    59→      .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
    60→
    61→    // Find the image by id
    62→    const pairIndex = sortedImages.findIndex((img) => img.id === pairShotGenerationId);
    63→    if (pairIndex === -1) {
    64→      return;
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    const startImage = sortedImages[pairIndex];
    68→    const startFrame = startImage.timeline_frame ?? 0;
    69→    const isTrailingSegment = pairIndex === sortedImages.length - 1;
    70→
    71→    // Calculate effective frame count (capped at maxFrameLimit)
    72→    const effectiveNewFrameCount = Math.min(newFrameCount, maxFrameLimit);
    73→
    74→    // Handle trailing segment (no end image) - update via position system or fallback to direct DB write
    75→    if (isTrailingSegment) {
    76→      const newEndFrame = startFrame + effectiveNewFrameCount;
    77→
    78→      // Preferred path: update through the position system for instant optimistic updates.
    79→      // The position system (updatePositions) handles both the visual update and the DB persist.
    80→      if (trailingFrameUpdateRef?.current) {
    81→        trailingFrameUpdateRef.current(newEndFrame);
    82→        return { finalFrameCount: effectiveNewFrameCount };
    83→      }
    84→
    85→      // Fallback: direct DB write + reload (used when position system not connected, e.g. batch mode)
    86→      const { data: current, error: fetchError } = await supabase
    87→        .from('shot_generations')
    88→        .select('metadata')
    89→        .eq('id', pairShotGenerationId)
    90→        .single();
    91→
    92→      if (fetchError) {
    93→        console.error('[useFrameCountUpdater] Error fetching metadata:', fetchError);
    94→        return;
    95→      }
    96→
    97→      const currentMetadata = (current?.metadata as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
    98→
    99→      const { error: updateError } = await supabase
   100→        .from('shot_generations')
   101→        .update({
   102→          metadata: {
   103→            ...currentMetadata,
   104→            end_frame: newEndFrame,
   105→          },
   106→        })
   107→        .eq('id', pairShotGenerationId);
   108→
   109→      if (updateError) {
   110→        console.error('[useFrameCountUpdater] Error updating end_frame:', updateError);
   111→        return;
   112→      }
   113→
   114→      if (loadPositions) {
   115→        await loadPositions({ silent: true, reason: 'end-frame-update' });
   116→      }
   117→
   118→      return { finalFrameCount: effectiveNewFrameCount };
   119→    }
   120→
   121→    // Standard case: pair with end image - shift subsequent images
   122→    const endImage = sortedImages[pairIndex + 1];
   123→    const currentFrameCount = (endImage.timeline_frame ?? 0) - startFrame;
   124→    const exceedsMax = newFrameCount > maxFrameLimit;
   125→
   126→    // Collect subsequent pairs for potential compression
   127→    const subsequentPairs: Array<{ startIdx: number; endIdx: number; originalFrames: number }> = [];
   128→    for (let j = pairIndex + 1; j < sortedImages.length - 1; j++) {
   129→      const pairStart = sortedImages[j];
   130→      const pairEnd = sortedImages[j + 1];
   131→      subsequentPairs.push({
   132→        startIdx: j,
   133→        endIdx: j + 1,
   134→        originalFrames: (pairEnd.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (pairStart.timeline_frame ?? 0),
   135→      });
   136→    }
   137→
   138→    // Calculate how much we can borrow from subsequent pairs
   139→    const overflow = exceedsMax ? newFrameCount - maxFrameLimit : 0;
   140→    const needsCompression = overflow > 0 && subsequentPairs.length > 0;
   141→    const totalSubsequentFrames = subsequentPairs.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.originalFrames, 0);
   142→    const minTotalSubsequent = subsequentPairs.length; // 1 frame minimum per pair
   143→    const maxBorrowable = Math.max(0, totalSubsequentFrames - minTotalSubsequent);
   144→    const actualBorrow = Math.min(overflow, maxBorrowable);
   145→    const finalFrameCount = effectiveNewFrameCount + actualBorrow;
   146→    const finalDelta = finalFrameCount - currentFrameCount;
   147→
   148→    if (finalDelta === 0) {
   149→      return;
   150→    }
   151→
   152→    // Calculate new positions
   153→    const updates: Array<{ id: string; newFrame: number }> = [];
   154→
   155→    if (needsCompression && actualBorrow > 0) {
   156→      // Compress subsequent pairs proportionally
   157→      const targetTotal = totalSubsequentFrames - actualBorrow;
   158→      const compressionRatio = targetTotal / totalSubsequentFrames;
   159→
   160→      let currentFrame = startFrame + finalFrameCount;
   161→      updates.push({ id: sortedImages[pairIndex + 1].id, newFrame: currentFrame });
   162→
   163→      for (let i = 0; i < subsequentPairs.length; i++) {
   164→        const pair = subsequentPairs[i];
   165→        const compressedFrames = Math.max(1, Math.min(maxFrameLimit, Math.round(pair.originalFrames * compressionRatio)));
   166→        currentFrame += compressedFrames;
   167→
   168→        if (pair.endIdx < sortedImages.length) {
   169→          updates.push({ id: sortedImages[pair.endIdx].id, newFrame: currentFrame });
   170→        }
   171→      }
   172→    } else {
   173→      // Simple shift: add delta to all subsequent images
   174→      for (let j = pairIndex + 1; j < sortedImages.length; j++) {
   175→        const img = sortedImages[j];
   176→        const newFrame = (img.timeline_frame ?? 0) + finalDelta;
   177→        updates.push({ id: img.id, newFrame });
   178→      }
   179→    }
   180→
   181→    // Apply updates to database
   182→    await Promise.all(updates.map(update =>
   183→      supabase
   184→        .from('shot_generations')
   185→        .update({ timeline_frame: update.newFrame })
   186→        .eq('id', update.id)
   187→    ));
   188→
   189→    // Refresh data
   190→    if (loadPositions) {
   191→      await loadPositions({ silent: true, reason: 'frame-count-update' });
   192→    }
   193→
   194→    return { finalFrameCount };
   195→  }, [shotGenerations, generationMode, loadPositions, maxFrameLimit, trailingFrameUpdateRef]);
   196→
   197→  return { updatePairFrameCount };
   198→}
   199→

1→/**
     2→ * Hook for computing pair data from shot generations.
     3→ * Pure computation - no side effects, no state management.
     4→ */
     5→
     6→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     7→import type { PairData } from '../../Timeline/TimelineContainer';
     8→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';
     9→import { isVideoAny } from '@/shared/lib/typeGuards';
    10→import { readSegmentOverrides } from '@/shared/utils/settingsMigration';
    11→
    12→interface UsePairDataProps {
    13→  /** Shot generations (images) */
    14→  shotGenerations: GenerationRow[];
    15→  /** Current generation mode */
    16→  generationMode: 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair';
    17→  /** Frame spacing for batch mode */
    18→  batchVideoFrames: number;
    19→}
    20→
    21→interface UsePairDataReturn {
    22→  /** Map of pair index to pair data */
    23→  pairDataByIndex: Map<number, PairData>;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/**
    27→ * Helper to read end_frame from image metadata.
    28→ * Returns undefined if not set.
    29→ */
    30→function getEndFrameFromMetadata(metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): number | undefined {
    31→  if (!metadata) return undefined;
    32→  const endFrame = metadata.end_frame;
    33→  return typeof endFrame === 'number' ? endFrame : undefined;
    34→}
    35→
    36→/**
    37→ * Computes pair data from shot generations.
    38→ * Each pair represents two consecutive images that can generate a video segment.
    39→ *
    40→ * For the last image (or single image), if metadata.end_frame is set, a trailing
    41→ * pair is created with endImage: undefined. This handles both single-image mode
    42→ * and multi-image timelines with a trailing segment.
    43→ */
    44→export function usePairData({
    45→  shotGenerations,
    46→  generationMode,
    47→  batchVideoFrames,
    48→}: UsePairDataProps): UsePairDataReturn {
    49→  return useMemo(() => {
    50→    const dataMap = new Map<number, PairData>();
    51→
    52→    // Filter and sort images
    53→    const sortedImages = [...(shotGenerations || [])]
    54→      .filter((img) => img.timeline_frame != null && img.timeline_frame >= 0 && !isVideoAny(img))
    55→      .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
    56→
    57→    if (sortedImages.length === 0) {
    58→      return { pairDataByIndex: dataMap };
    59→    }
    60→
    61→    const isBatchMode = generationMode !== 'timeline';
    62→
    63→    // Build pairs from consecutive images
    64→    for (let pairIndex = 0; pairIndex < sortedImages.length - 1; pairIndex++) {
    65→      const startImage = sortedImages[pairIndex];
    66→      const endImage = sortedImages[pairIndex + 1];
    67→
    68→      // Read per-segment overrides from metadata
    69→      const startImageOverrides = readSegmentOverrides(startImage.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
    70→      const pairNumFramesFromMetadata = startImageOverrides.numFrames;
    71→
    72→      // Calculate frame positions based on mode
    73→      const startFrame = isBatchMode
    74→        ? pairIndex * batchVideoFrames
    75→        : (startImage.timeline_frame ?? 0);
    76→      const endFrame = isBatchMode
    77→        ? (pairIndex + 1) * batchVideoFrames
    78→        : (endImage.timeline_frame ?? 0);
    79→      const frames = isBatchMode
    80→        ? (pairNumFramesFromMetadata ?? batchVideoFrames)
    81→        : endFrame - startFrame;
    82→
    83→      dataMap.set(pairIndex, {
    84→        index: pairIndex,
    85→        frames,
    86→        startFrame,
    87→        endFrame,
    88→        startImage: {
    89→          id: startImage.id,
    90→          generationId: startImage.generation_id,
    91→          primaryVariantId: startImage.primary_variant_id || undefined,
    92→          url: startImage.imageUrl || startImage.location,
    93→          thumbUrl: startImage.thumbUrl || startImage.location,
    94→          position: pairIndex + 1,
    95→        },
    96→        endImage: {
    97→          id: endImage.id,
    98→          generationId: endImage.generation_id,
    99→          primaryVariantId: endImage.primary_variant_id || undefined,
   100→          url: endImage.imageUrl || endImage.location,
   101→          thumbUrl: endImage.thumbUrl || endImage.location,
   102→          position: pairIndex + 2,
   103→        },
   104→      });
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    // Check if the last image has an end_frame for a trailing segment
   108→    // This handles both single-image (sortedImages.length === 1) and multi-image trailing segments
   109→    const lastImage = sortedImages[sortedImages.length - 1];
   110→    const lastImageEndFrame = getEndFrameFromMetadata(lastImage.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   111→
   112→    if (lastImageEndFrame !== undefined) {
   113→      const trailingPairIndex = sortedImages.length - 1;
   114→      const startFrame = isBatchMode
   115→        ? trailingPairIndex * batchVideoFrames
   116→        : (lastImage.timeline_frame ?? 0);
   117→
   118→      // Read numFrames override for batch mode
   119→      const lastImageOverrides = readSegmentOverrides(lastImage.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   120→      const trailingNumFrames = lastImageOverrides.numFrames;
   121→
   122→      const frames = isBatchMode
   123→        ? (trailingNumFrames ?? batchVideoFrames)
   124→        : lastImageEndFrame - startFrame;
   125→
   126→      dataMap.set(trailingPairIndex, {
   127→        index: trailingPairIndex,
   128→        frames,
   129→        startFrame,
   130→        endFrame: lastImageEndFrame,
   131→        startImage: {
   132→          id: lastImage.id,
   133→          generationId: lastImage.generation_id,
   134→          primaryVariantId: lastImage.primary_variant_id || undefined,
   135→          url: lastImage.imageUrl || lastImage.location,
   136→          thumbUrl: lastImage.thumbUrl || lastImage.location,
   137→          position: trailingPairIndex + 1,
   138→        },
   139→        endImage: undefined,
   140→      });
   141→    }
   142→
   143→    return { pairDataByIndex: dataMap };
   144→  }, [shotGenerations, generationMode, batchVideoFrames]);
   145→}
   146→

1→/**
     2→ * Hook for computing preview segments from shot generations and segment slots.
     3→ */
     4→
     5→import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
     6→import { getDisplayUrl } from '@/shared/lib/utils';
     7→import type { PreviewSegment } from '../types';
     8→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';
     9→import type { SegmentSlot } from '@/shared/hooks/segments';
    10→
    11→export interface UsePreviewSegmentsReturn {
    12→  /** Whether the preview dialog is open */
    13→  isPreviewTogetherOpen: boolean;
    14→  /** Setter for preview dialog open state */
    15→  setIsPreviewTogetherOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
    16→  /** All segments that can be previewed (have video OR have both images) */
    17→  previewableSegments: PreviewSegment[];
    18→  /** Whether there are any segments to preview */
    19→  hasVideosToPreview: boolean;
    20→}
    21→
    22→interface UsePreviewSegmentsProps {
    23→  /** Current generation mode */
    24→  generationMode: 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair';
    25→  /** Frame spacing for batch mode */
    26→  batchVideoFrames: number;
    27→  /** All shot generations (images) */
    28→  shotGenerations: GenerationRow[];
    29→  /** Segment slots with video data */
    30→  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[];
    31→}
    32→
    33→export function usePreviewSegments({
    34→  generationMode,
    35→  batchVideoFrames,
    36→  shotGenerations,
    37→  segmentSlots,
    38→}: UsePreviewSegmentsProps): UsePreviewSegmentsReturn {
    39→  const [isPreviewTogetherOpen, setIsPreviewTogetherOpen] = useState(false);
    40→
    41→  // Get ALL segments for preview (both with videos and image-only)
    42→  // Build from IMAGE PAIRS, not segmentSlots - otherwise we miss image-only segments
    43→  const allSegmentsForPreview = useMemo(() => {
    44→    // Get sorted images to find start/end for each pair
    45→    const sortedImages = [...(shotGenerations || [])]
    46→      .filter((img) => img.timeline_frame != null && img.timeline_frame >= 0)
    47→      .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
    48→
    49→    // Build a lookup of segment slots by index for quick access
    50→    const slotsByIndex = new Map<number, SegmentSlot>();
    51→    segmentSlots.forEach(slot => {
    52→      slotsByIndex.set(slot.index, slot);
    53→    });
    54→
    55→    // Number of pairs = number of images - 1 (each pair is consecutive images)
    56→    const numPairs = Math.max(0, sortedImages.length - 1);
    57→
    58→    // FPS for calculating duration from frames
    59→    const FPS = 16;
    60→    const isBatchMode = generationMode !== 'timeline';
    61→
    62→    // Build segments from ALL image pairs, enriching with video data from slots if available
    63→    const segments: PreviewSegment[] = [];
    64→    for (let pairIndex = 0; pairIndex < numPairs; pairIndex++) {
    65→      // Get start and end images for this pair
    66→      const startImage = sortedImages[pairIndex];
    67→      const endImage = sortedImages[pairIndex + 1];
    68→
    69→      // Get frame positions for timeline mode calculation
    70→      const startFrame = startImage?.timeline_frame ?? 0;
    71→      const endFrame = endImage?.timeline_frame ?? startFrame;
    72→
    73→      // Calculate duration - in batch mode use uniform batchVideoFrames, otherwise from timeline positions
    74→      const durationFromFrames = isBatchMode
    75→        ? batchVideoFrames / FPS  // Batch mode: uniform duration for all pairs
    76→        : (endFrame - startFrame) / FPS;  // Timeline mode: from actual frame positions
    77→
    78→      // Check if there's a slot with video for this pair
    79→      const slot = slotsByIndex.get(pairIndex);
    80→      const hasVideoInSlot = slot?.type === 'child' && !!slot.child?.location;
    81→
    82→      if (hasVideoInSlot && slot?.type === 'child') {
    83→        // Has video
    84→        segments.push({
    85→          hasVideo: true,
    86→          videoUrl: getDisplayUrl(slot.child.location),
    87→          thumbUrl: getDisplayUrl(slot.child.thumbUrl || slot.child.location),
    88→          startImageUrl: startImage?.imageUrl || startImage?.thumbUrl || null,
    89→          endImageUrl: endImage?.imageUrl || endImage?.thumbUrl || null,
    90→          index: pairIndex,
    91→          durationFromFrames, // Used as fallback if video duration fails to load
    92→        });
    93→      } else {
    94→        // No video - will show crossfade
    95→        segments.push({
    96→          hasVideo: false,
    97→          videoUrl: null,
    98→          thumbUrl: startImage?.thumbUrl || startImage?.imageUrl || null,
    99→          startImageUrl: startImage?.imageUrl || startImage?.thumbUrl || null,
   100→          endImageUrl: endImage?.imageUrl || endImage?.thumbUrl || null,
   101→          index: pairIndex,
   102→          durationFromFrames,
   103→        });
   104→      }
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    return segments;
   108→  }, [segmentSlots, shotGenerations, generationMode, batchVideoFrames]);
   109→
   110→  // Filter to just segments we can actually preview (have video OR have both images)
   111→  const previewableSegments = useMemo(() => {
   112→    return allSegmentsForPreview.filter(seg =>
   113→      seg.hasVideo || (seg.startImageUrl && seg.endImageUrl)
   114→    );
   115→  }, [allSegmentsForPreview]);
   116→
   117→  const hasVideosToPreview = previewableSegments.length > 0;
   118→
   119→  return {
   120→    isPreviewTogetherOpen,
   121→    setIsPreviewTogetherOpen,
   122→    previewableSegments,
   123→    hasVideosToPreview,
   124→  };
   125→}
   126→

    72→
    73→export function useShotGenerationsData({

   129→      updateTimelineFrame: coreHookData.updatePosition,
   130→      batchExchangePositions: coreHookData.commitPositions,
   131→      loadPositions: coreHookData.refetch,
   132→      updatePairPrompts: coreHookData.updatePairPrompts,
   133→      clearEnhancedPrompt: coreHookData.clearEnhancedPrompt,
   134→      initializeTimelineFrames: async () => {},

   137→      exchangePositionsNoReload: async () => {},
   138→      deleteItem: coreHookData.deleteItem,
   139→      updatePairPromptsByIndex: coreHookData.updatePairPromptsByIndex,

   152→  const shotGenerations = preloadedImages || hookData.shotGenerations;

   217→    getImagesForMode: hookData.getImagesForMode,

    16→
    17→export interface BatchModeContentProps {
    18→  // Core
    19→  selectedShotId: string;
    20→  projectId?: string;

   128→/**
   129→ * Create variant on parent for single-item cases
   130→ */
   131→export async function createSingleItemVariant(
   132→  ctx: HandlerContext,
   133→  parentGenerationId: string
   134→): Promise<any | null> {
   135→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, childOrder } = ctx;
   136→
   137→  // Check if this is first variant on parent
   138→  const { count: existingVariantCount } = await supabase
   139→    .from('generation_variants')
   140→    .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   141→    .eq('generation_id', parentGenerationId);
   142→  const isFirstVariant = (existingVariantCount || 0) === 0;
   143→
   144→  const toolType = taskData.params?.full_orchestrator_payload?.tool_type ||
   145→                   taskData.params?.tool_type ||
   146→                   taskData.tool_type;
   147→
   148→  const variantType = taskData.variant_type || VARIANT_TYPE_DEFAULT;
   149→
   150→  const result = await createVariantOnParent(
   151→    supabase, parentGenerationId, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, taskData, taskId,
   152→    variantType,
   153→    {
   154→      tool_type: toolType,
   155→      created_from: 'single_item_completion',
   156→      is_single_item: true,
   157→      child_order: childOrder ?? 0,
   158→    },
   159→    null,
   160→    isFirstVariant
   161→  );
   162→
   163→  return result;
   164→}

   166→/**
   167→ * Find existing generation at a position (for variant creation)
   168→ */
   169→export async function findExistingGenerationAtPosition(
   170→  supabase: any,
   171→  parentGenerationId: string,
   172→  childOrder: number,
   173→  pairShotGenId?: string
   174→): Promise<string | null> {
   175→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Checking for existing generation at segment_index=${childOrder}, pair_shot_gen_id=${pairShotGenId || 'none'}`);
   176→
   177→  // Strategy 1: Try to find by pair_shot_generation_id column
   178→  if (pairShotGenId) {
   179→    // Match by the FK column (source of truth with referential integrity)
   180→    const { data: matchByColumn, error: matchByColumnError } = await supabase
   181→      .from('generations')
   182→      .select('id')
   183→      .eq('parent_generation_id', parentGenerationId)
   184→      .eq('is_child', true)
   185→      .eq('pair_shot_generation_id', pairShotGenId)
   186→      .maybeSingle();
   187→
   188→    if (!matchByColumnError && matchByColumn?.id) {
   189→      console.log(`[GenHandler] Found match by pair_shot_generation_id column: ${matchByColumn.id}`);
   190→      return matchByColumn.id;
   191→    }
   192→
   193→    // NOTE: We intentionally DON'T fall back to params JSONB here.
   194→    // Pre-migration generations have already been migrated to the column.
   195→    // Any generation with NULL column but non-NULL params is orphaned
   196→    // (FK cascade set column to NULL when shot_generation was deleted).
   197→    console.log(`[GenHandler] No match by pair_shot_generation_id column`);
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Strategy 2: Fallback to child_order match
   201→  // IMPORTANT: Only use this fallback when NO pair_shot_generation_id was provided
   202→  // If pairShotGenId was provided but no match found, DON'T fall back to child_order
   203→  // because the existing child at that index may be for a different timeline layout
   204→  if (!pairShotGenId) {
   205→    const { data: matchByChildOrder, error: matchByChildOrderError } = await supabase
   206→      .from('generations')
   207→      .select('id')
   208→      .eq('parent_generation_id', parentGenerationId)
   209→      .eq('is_child', true)
   210→      .eq('child_order', childOrder)
   211→      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
   212→      .limit(1)
   213→      .maybeSingle();
   214→
   215→    if (!matchByChildOrderError && matchByChildOrder?.id) {
   216→      console.log(`[GenHandler] Found match by child_order=${childOrder}: ${matchByChildOrder.id}`);
   217→      return matchByChildOrder.id;
   218→    }
   219→  } else {
   220→    console.log(`[GenHandler] No match by pair_shot_generation_id, skipping child_order fallback (would match wrong slot after timeline rearrangement)`);
   221→  }
   222→
   223→  console.log(`[GenHandler] No existing generation found at position`);
   224→  return null;
   225→}

   227→/**
   228→ * Create the child generation record and its initial variant

   230→export async function createChildGenerationRecord(
   231→  ctx: HandlerContext,
   232→  parentGenerationId: string,
   233→  childOrder: number | null,
   234→  isSingleItemCase: boolean,
   235→  pairShotGenerationId?: string | null | false
   236→): Promise<any> {
   237→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, logger } = ctx;
   238→
   239→  const { shotId } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   240→  const generationType = taskData.content_type || 'video';
   241→  const toolType = taskData.tool_type;
   242→  let generationParams = buildGenerationParams(
   243→    taskData.params, toolType, generationType, shotId, thumbnailUrl || undefined, taskId
   244→  );
   245→
   246→  // Ensure pair_shot_generation_id is at top level of params (for slot matching)
   247→  if (pairShotGenerationId && !generationParams.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   248→    generationParams = { ...generationParams, pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenerationId };
   249→    console.log(`[GenHandler] Added pair_shot_generation_id to child generation params: ${pairShotGenerationId}`);
   250→  }
   251→
   252→  const newGenerationId = crypto.randomUUID();
   253→
   254→  const generationName = taskData.params?.generation_name ||
   255→    taskData.params?.orchestrator_details?.generation_name ||
   256→    taskData.params?.full_orchestrator_payload?.generation_name;
   257→
   258→  // Find based_on
   259→  let basedOnGenerationId: string | null = extractBasedOn(taskData.params);
   260→  if (basedOnGenerationId) {
   261→    const { data: basedOnGen, error: basedOnError } = await supabase
   262→      .from('generations')
   263→      .select('id')
   264→      .eq('id', basedOnGenerationId)
   265→      .maybeSingle();
   266→
   267→    if (basedOnError || !basedOnGen) {
   268→      console.warn(`[GenHandler] based_on generation ${basedOnGenerationId} not found, clearing reference`);
   269→      basedOnGenerationId = null;
   270→    }
   271→  }
   272→  if (!basedOnGenerationId) {
   273→    const sourceImageUrl = taskData.params?.image;
   274→    if (sourceImageUrl) {
   275→      basedOnGenerationId = await findSourceGenerationByImageUrl(supabase, sourceImageUrl);
   276→    }
   277→  }
   278→
   279→  logger?.info("Creating child generation record", {
   280→    task_id: taskId,
   281→    generation_id: newGenerationId,
   282→    parent_generation_id: parentGenerationId,
   283→    child_order: childOrder,
   284→    is_single_item: isSingleItemCase,
   285→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   286→    pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenerationId || null,
   287→  });
   288→
   289→  // Verify pair_shot_generation_id still exists before inserting (FK constraint check)
   290→  // If the shot_generation was deleted between task creation and completion, set to NULL
   291→  let validatedPairShotGenId = pairShotGenerationId || null;
   292→  if (validatedPairShotGenId) {
   293→    let shotGenQuery = supabase
   294→      .from('shot_generations')
   295→      .select('id')
   296→      .eq('id', validatedPairShotGenId);
   297→
   298→    // Scope to current shot to avoid matching a generation in a different shot
   299→    if (shotId) {
   300→      shotGenQuery = shotGenQuery.eq('shot_id', shotId);
   301→    }
   302→
   303→    const { data: shotGenExists } = await shotGenQuery.maybeSingle();
   304→
   305→    if (!shotGenExists) {
   306→      console.log(`[GenHandler] pair_shot_generation_id ${validatedPairShotGenId} no longer exists${shotId ? ` in shot ${shotId}` : ''}, setting to NULL`);
   307→      validatedPairShotGenId = null;
   308→    }
   309→  }
   310→
   311→  const generationRecord: Record<string, any> = {
   312→    id: newGenerationId,
   313→    tasks: [taskId],
   314→    params: generationParams,
   315→    type: generationType,
   316→    project_id: taskData.project_id,
   317→    name: generationName,
   318→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   319→    parent_generation_id: parentGenerationId,
   320→    is_child: true,
   321→    child_order: childOrder,
   322→    // Store pair_shot_generation_id as proper column (not just in params)
   323→    // This enables FK constraint and ON DELETE SET NULL behavior
   324→    // Validated above to prevent FK violation if shot_generation was deleted
   325→    pair_shot_generation_id: validatedPairShotGenId,
   326→    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   327→  };
   328→
   329→  const newGeneration = await insertGeneration(supabase, generationRecord);
   330→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Created child generation ${newGeneration.id}`);
   331→
   332→  // Log segment state for debugging (travel segments only)
   333→  const isTravelSegmentTask = taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_SEGMENT ||
   334→                               taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.INDIVIDUAL_TRAVEL_SEGMENT;
   335→  const orchDetails = taskData.params?.orchestrator_details ||
   336→                      taskData.params?.full_orchestrator_payload || {};
   337→
   338→  if (isTravelSegmentTask && childOrder !== null) {
   339→    try {

   341→        taskId,
   342→        generationId: newGeneration.id,
   343→        segmentIndex: childOrder,
   344→        parentGenerationId,
   345→        orchDetails,
   346→        segmentParams: taskData.params,
   347→        shotId,
   348→      });
   349→    } catch (logError) {
   350→      console.warn('[GenHandler] Error logging segment state:', logError);
   351→    }
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  // Create "original" variant
   355→  let autoViewedAt: string | null = null;
   356→  let createdFrom = 'child_generation_original';
   357→
   358→  if (isSingleItemCase) {
   359→    autoViewedAt = new Date().toISOString();

   361→  } else {
   362→    autoViewedAt = await getChildVariantViewedAt(supabase, {
   363→      taskParams: taskData.params,
   364→    });
   365→    if (autoViewedAt) {
   366→      createdFrom = 'single_segment_child_original';
   367→    }
   368→  }
   369→
   370→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Creating original variant${autoViewedAt ? ' (auto-viewed)' : ''}`);
   371→  await createVariant(
   372→    supabase, newGeneration.id, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl,
   373→    { ...generationParams, source_task_id: taskId, created_from: createdFrom },
   374→    true, 'original', null, autoViewedAt
   375→  );
   376→
   377→  await supabase.from('tasks').update({ generation_created: true }).eq('id', taskId);
   378→
   379→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Child generation creation complete`);
   380→  return newGeneration;
   381→}

   509→  console.log(`${TAG}   Model Type: ${orchDetails?.model_type || segmentParams?.model_type || 'i2v'}`);
   510→  console.log(`${TAG}   Seed: ${orchDetails?.seed_base || segmentParams?.seed || '(random)'}`);
   511→  console.log(`${TAG}   Amount of Motion: ${orchDetails?.amount_of_motion !== undefined ? Math.round(orchDetails.amount_of_motion * 100) + '%' : '(default)'}`);
   512→  console.log(`${TAG}   Advanced Mode: ${orchDetails?.advanced_mode || false}`);

   515→

   520→    Object.entries(additionalLoras).forEach(([path, strength]) => {

   525→    const uniqueLoras = new Set<string>();

   531→    }

   536→  // SECTION 5: ORCHESTRATOR CONTEXT

   540→  console.log(`${TAG}   Total Images: ${inputImages.length}`);
   541→  console.log(`${TAG}   Generation Mode: ${orchDetails?.generation_mode || 'batch'}`);
   542→  console.log(`${TAG}   Generation Name: ${orchDetails?.generation_name || '(unnamed)'}`);
   543→  console.log(`${TAG}   Resolution: ${orchDetails?.parsed_resolution_wh || '(auto)'}`);
   544→
   545→  if (segmentFramesExpanded.length > 0) {

   547→    const totalFrames = segmentFramesExpanded.reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0);
   548→    console.log(`${TAG}   Total Duration: ${totalFrames} frames (~${(totalFrames / 24).toFixed(1)}s)`);
   549→  }

   552→}
   553→
   554→/**
   555→ * Extract segment-specific params from expanded arrays in orchestrator_details.
   556→ * For travel segments, each segment can have different prompts, frame counts, etc.
   557→ */
   558→export function extractSegmentSpecificParams(
   559→  params: any,
   560→  orchDetails: any,
   561→  segmentIndex: number
   562→): any {
   563→  const specificParams = { ...params };
   564→
   565→  const specificPrompt = extractFromArray(orchDetails.base_prompts_expanded, segmentIndex);
   566→  if (specificPrompt !== undefined) {
   567→    specificParams.prompt = specificPrompt;
   568→    console.log(`[GenMigration] Set child prompt: "${String(specificPrompt).substring(0, 20)}..."`);
   569→  }
   570→
   571→  const specificNegativePrompt = extractFromArray(orchDetails.negative_prompts_expanded, segmentIndex);
   572→  if (specificNegativePrompt !== undefined) {
   573→    specificParams.negative_prompt = specificNegativePrompt;
   574→  }
   575→
   576→  const specificFrames = extractFromArray(orchDetails.segment_frames_expanded, segmentIndex);
   577→  if (specificFrames !== undefined) {
   578→    specificParams.num_frames = specificFrames;
   579→  }
   580→
   581→  const specificOverlap = extractFromArray(orchDetails.frame_overlap_expanded, segmentIndex);
   582→  if (specificOverlap !== undefined) {
   583→    specificParams.frame_overlap = specificOverlap;
   584→  }
   585→
   586→  const pairShotGenId = extractFromArray(orchDetails.pair_shot_generation_ids, segmentIndex);
   587→  if (pairShotGenId !== undefined) {
   588→    specificParams.pair_shot_generation_id = pairShotGenId;
   589→    console.log(`[GenMigration] Set pair_shot_generation_id: ${pairShotGenId}`);
   590→  }
   591→
   592→  const startImageGenId = extractFromArray(orchDetails.input_image_generation_ids, segmentIndex);
   593→  if (startImageGenId !== undefined) {
   594→    specificParams.start_image_generation_id = startImageGenId;
   595→  }
   596→  const endImageGenId = extractFromArray(orchDetails.input_image_generation_ids, segmentIndex + 1);
   597→  if (endImageGenId !== undefined) {
   598→    specificParams.end_image_generation_id = endImageGenId;
   599→  }
   600→
   601→  return specificParams;
   602→}
