   128→// ==================== Fetch Task ====================
   129→
   130→export const fetchTask = async (taskId: string): Promise<TaskData | null> => {
   131→  
   132→  try {
   133→    const { data, error } = await supabase
   134→      .from('tasks')
   135→      .select('*')
   136→      .eq('id', taskId)
   137→      .single();
   138→    
   139→    if (error || !data) {
   140→      console.error('[ApplySettings] ❌ Failed to fetch task:', error);
   141→      return null;
   142→    }
   143→    
   144→    const params = (data.params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   145→    const orchestrator = (params.orchestrator_details || params.full_orchestrator_payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   146→    
   147→    return { params, orchestrator };
   148→  } catch (queryError) {
   149→    console.error('[ApplySettings] ❌ Exception fetching task:', queryError);
   150→    return null;
   151→  }
   152→};
   153→
   154→// ==================== Extract Settings ====================
   155→
   156→export const extractSettings = (taskData: TaskData): ExtractedSettings => {
   157→  // Cast to permissive record for dynamic property access from Supabase JSON
   158→  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
   159→  const params = taskData.params as Record<string, any>;
   160→  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
   161→  const orchestrator = taskData.orchestrator as Record<string, any>;
   162→  
   163→  // Extract all settings with fallbacks
   164→  const extracted: ExtractedSettings = {
   165→    // Prompts
   166→    prompt: (
   167→      (orchestrator.base_prompts_expanded?.[0] && orchestrator.base_prompts_expanded[0].trim()) ||
   168→      (orchestrator.base_prompt && orchestrator.base_prompt.trim()) ||
   169→      (params.prompt && params.prompt.trim()) ||
   170→      undefined
   171→    ),
   172→    prompts: orchestrator.base_prompts_expanded,
   173→    negativePrompt: orchestrator.negative_prompts_expanded?.[0] ?? params.negative_prompt,
   174→    negativePrompts: orchestrator.negative_prompts_expanded,
   175→    
   176→    // Generation settings
   177→    steps: orchestrator.steps ?? params.num_inference_steps,
   178→    frames: orchestrator.segment_frames_expanded?.[0] ?? params.segment_frames_expanded, // Legacy: single value for backward compat
   179→    segmentFramesExpanded: orchestrator.segment_frames_expanded ?? params.segment_frames_expanded, // NEW: full array of gaps
   180→    context: orchestrator.frame_overlap_expanded?.[0] ?? params.frame_overlap_expanded,
   181→    model: params.model_name ?? orchestrator.model_name,
   182→    
   183→    // Modes
   184→    generationMode: orchestrator.generation_mode ?? params.generation_mode,
   185→    // model_type is the existing field that stores I2V vs VACE mode
   186→    generationTypeMode: orchestrator.model_type ?? params.model_type,
   187→    advancedMode: orchestrator.advanced_mode ?? params.advanced_mode,
   188→    motionMode: orchestrator.motion_mode ?? params.motion_mode,
   189→    
   190→    // Advanced mode settings
   191→    phaseConfig: orchestrator.phase_config ?? params.phase_config,
   192→    selectedPhasePresetId: orchestrator.selected_phase_preset_id ?? params.selected_phase_preset_id,
   193→    turboMode: orchestrator.turbo_mode ?? params.turbo_mode,
   194→    enhancePrompt: orchestrator.enhance_prompt ?? params.enhance_prompt,
   195→    
   196→    // Text addons
   197→    textBeforePrompts: orchestrator.text_before_prompts ?? params.text_before_prompts,
   198→    textAfterPrompts: orchestrator.text_after_prompts ?? params.text_after_prompts,
   199→    
   200→    // Motion
   201→    amountOfMotion: orchestrator.amount_of_motion ?? params.amount_of_motion,
   202→    
   203→    // LoRAs - convert from object format to array format
   204→    // Backend stores as { "url": strength, ... } but we need [{ path, strength }, ...]
   205→    loras: (() => {
   206→      const loraData = orchestrator.loras ?? orchestrator.additional_loras ?? params.loras ?? params.additional_loras;
   207→      if (!loraData) return undefined;
   208→      
   209→      // If already array format, return as-is
   210→      if (Array.isArray(loraData)) return loraData;
   211→      
   212→      // Convert object format to array format
   213→      return Object.entries(loraData).map(([path, strength]) => ({
   214→        path,
   215→        strength: strength as number
   216→      }));
   217→    })(),
   218→    
   219→    // Structure video
   220→    structureVideoPath: orchestrator.structure_video_path ?? params.structure_video_path,
   221→    structureVideoTreatment: orchestrator.structure_video_treatment ?? params.structure_video_treatment,
   222→    structureVideoMotionStrength: orchestrator.structure_video_motion_strength ?? params.structure_video_motion_strength,
   223→    // Note: Backend uses both "structure_type" and "structure_video_type" - check both
   224→    structureVideoType: orchestrator.structure_video_type ?? orchestrator.structure_type ?? params.structure_video_type ?? params.structure_type,
   225→    
   226→    // Input images - extract from multiple possible locations
   227→    inputImages: (() => {
   228→      const cleanUrl = (url: string): string => {
   229→        if (typeof url !== 'string') return url;
   230→        return url.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
   231→      };
   232→      
   233→      if (Array.isArray(params.input_images) && params.input_images.length > 0) {
   234→        return params.input_images.map(cleanUrl);
   235→      }
   236→      if (orchestrator.input_image_paths_resolved && Array.isArray(orchestrator.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
   237→        return orchestrator.input_image_paths_resolved.map(cleanUrl);
   238→      }
   239→      if (Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
   240→        return params.input_image_paths_resolved.map(cleanUrl);
   241→      }
   242→      return undefined;
   243→    })(),
   244→  };
   245→  
   246→  return extracted;
   247→};
   248→
   249→// ==================== Apply Functions ====================
   250→
   251→export const applyModelSettings = async (
   252→  settings: ExtractedSettings,
   253→  context: ApplyContext
   254→): Promise<ApplyResult> => {
   255→  if (!settings.model || settings.model === context.steerableMotionSettings.model_name) {
   256→    return { success: true, settingName: 'model', details: 'skipped - no change' };
   257→  }
   258→  
   259→  context.onSteerableMotionSettingsChange({ model_name: settings.model });
   260→  
   261→  return { success: true, settingName: 'model', details: settings.model };
   262→};
   263→
   264→export const applyPromptSettings = async (
   265→  settings: ExtractedSettings,
   266→  context: ApplyContext
   267→): Promise<ApplyResult> => {
   268→  // Apply main prompt
   269→  if (typeof settings.prompt === 'string' && settings.prompt.trim()) {
   270→    context.onBatchVideoPromptChange(settings.prompt);
   271→  }
   272→  
   273→  // Apply individual prompts to pair configs (regardless of current mode)
   274→  if (settings.prompts && settings.prompts.length > 1 && context.updatePairPromptsByIndex) {
   275→    
   276→    const errors: string[] = [];
   277→    
   278→    for (let i = 0; i < settings.prompts.length; i++) {
   279→      const pairPrompt = settings.prompts[i]?.trim();
   280→      const pairNegativePrompt = settings.negativePrompts?.[i]?.trim() || '';
   281→      
   282→      if (pairPrompt) {
   283→        try {
   284→          await context.updatePairPromptsByIndex(i, pairPrompt, pairNegativePrompt);
   285→        } catch (e) {
   286→          console.error(`[ApplySettings] ❌ Failed to apply prompt for pair ${i}:`, e);
   287→          errors.push(`Pair ${i}: ${e}`);
   288→        }
   289→      }
   290→    }
   291→    
   292→    if (errors.length > 0) {
   293→      return { success: false, settingName: 'prompts', error: errors.join('; ') };
   294→    }
   295→  }
   296→  
   297→  // Apply negative prompt
   298→  if (settings.negativePrompt !== undefined) {
   299→    context.onSteerableMotionSettingsChange({ negative_prompt: settings.negativePrompt || '' });
   300→  }
   301→  
   302→  return { success: true, settingName: 'prompts' };
   303→};

   314→  // Apply context

   316→

   325→export const applyModeSettings = async (

   351→
   352→export const applyAdvancedModeSettings = async (
   353→  settings: ExtractedSettings,
   354→  context: ApplyContext
   355→): Promise<ApplyResult> => {
   356→  // Helper to deep clone phase config to prevent shared references
   357→  const deepClonePhaseConfig = (config: typeof settings.phaseConfig) => {
   358→    if (!config) return undefined;
   359→    return {
   360→      ...config,
   361→      steps_per_phase: [...config.steps_per_phase],
   362→      phases: config.phases.map(phase => ({
   363→        ...phase,
   364→        loras: phase.loras.map(lora => ({ ...lora }))
   365→      }))
   366→    };
   367→  };
   368→  
   369→  // Apply phase config
   370→  if (settings.phaseConfig) {
   371→    // DEEP CLONE: Prevent shared references when applying task settings
   372→    const clonedConfig = deepClonePhaseConfig(settings.phaseConfig)!;
   373→    context.onPhaseConfigChange(clonedConfig);
   374→  }
   375→  
   376→  // Apply phase preset ID
   377→  if (settings.selectedPhasePresetId !== undefined) {
   378→    
   379→    if (settings.selectedPhasePresetId && context.onPhasePresetSelect && settings.phaseConfig) {
   380→      // Note: onPhasePresetSelect also deep clones, but we pass cloned config anyway for safety
   381→      const clonedConfig = deepClonePhaseConfig(settings.phaseConfig)!;
   382→      context.onPhasePresetSelect(settings.selectedPhasePresetId, clonedConfig);
   383→    } else if (!settings.selectedPhasePresetId && context.onPhasePresetRemove) {
   384→      context.onPhasePresetRemove();
   385→    }
   386→  }
   387→  
   388→  // Apply turbo mode
   389→  if (settings.turboMode !== undefined && context.onTurboModeChange) {
   390→    context.onTurboModeChange(settings.turboMode);
   391→  }
   392→  
   393→  // Apply enhance prompt
   394→  if (settings.enhancePrompt !== undefined && context.onEnhancePromptChange) {
   395→    context.onEnhancePromptChange(settings.enhancePrompt);
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return { success: true, settingName: 'advancedMode' };
   399→};

   525→
   526→// ==================== Apply Frame Positions ====================
   527→
   528→/**
   529→ * Apply frame positions from segment_frames_expanded to existing images
   530→ * This is used when settings are applied WITHOUT replacing images
   531→ */
   532→export const applyFramePositionsToExistingImages = async (
   533→  settings: ExtractedSettings,
   534→  selectedShot: Shot | null,
   535→  simpleFilteredImages: GenerationRow[]
   536→): Promise<ApplyResult> => {
   537→  const segmentGaps = settings.segmentFramesExpanded;
   538→  const hasSegmentGaps = Array.isArray(segmentGaps) && segmentGaps.length > 0;
   539→  
   540→  if (!hasSegmentGaps) {
   541→    return { success: true, settingName: 'framePositions', details: 'no data' };
   542→  }
   543→  
   544→  if (!selectedShot?.id) {
   545→    return { success: true, settingName: 'framePositions', details: 'skipped - no shot' };
   546→  }
   547→  
   548→  // Calculate cumulative positions from gaps
   549→  const cumulativePositions: number[] = [0]; // First image always at frame 0
   550→  for (let i = 0; i < segmentGaps.length; i++) {
   551→    const prevPosition = cumulativePositions[cumulativePositions.length - 1];
   552→    cumulativePositions.push(prevPosition + segmentGaps[i]);
   553→  }
   554→  
   555→  try {
   556→    // Update timeline_frame for each image
   557→    const updates = simpleFilteredImages.map(async (img, index) => {
   558→      // img.id is the shot_generations.id
   559→      if (!img.id) {
   560→        return null;
   561→      }
   562→      
   563→      // Use cumulative position if available
   564→      const newTimelineFrame = index < cumulativePositions.length 
   565→        ? cumulativePositions[index]
   566→        : cumulativePositions[cumulativePositions.length - 1] + (index - cumulativePositions.length + 1) * (segmentGaps[segmentGaps.length - 1] || 60);
   567→      
   568→      const { error } = await supabase
   569→        .from('shot_generations')
   570→        .update({ timeline_frame: newTimelineFrame })
   571→        .eq('id', img.id); // img.id is shot_generations.id
   572→      
   573→      if (error) {
   574→        console.error('[ApplySettings] ❌ Failed to update timeline_frame:', error);
   575→        return null;
   576→      }
   577→      
   578→      return { id: img.id, newTimelineFrame };
   579→    });
   580→    
   581→    const results = await Promise.all(updates);
   582→    const successCount = results.filter(r => r !== null).length;
   583→    
   584→    return {
   585→      success: true,
   586→      settingName: 'framePositions',
   587→      details: { updated: successCount, total: simpleFilteredImages.length }
   588→    };
   589→  } catch (e) {
   590→    const errorMessage = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
   591→    console.error('[ApplySettings] ❌ Error applying frame positions:', e);
   592→    return {
   593→      success: false,
   594→      settingName: 'framePositions',
   595→      error: errorMessage
   596→    };
   597→  }
   598→};
   599→
   600→// ==================== Replace Images ====================
   601→
   602→export const replaceImagesIfRequested = async (
   603→  settings: ExtractedSettings,
   604→  replaceImages: boolean,
   605→  inputImages: string[],
   606→  selectedShot: Shot | null,
   607→  projectId: string,
   608→  simpleFilteredImages: GenerationRow[],
   609→  addImageToShotMutation: { mutateAsync: (params: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown> },
   610→  removeImageFromShotMutation: { mutateAsync: (params: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown> }
   611→): Promise<ApplyResult> => {
   612→  if (!replaceImages) {
   613→    // NEW: Apply frame positions to existing images even when not replacing
   614→    return await applyFramePositionsToExistingImages(settings, selectedShot, simpleFilteredImages);
   615→  }
   616→  
   617→  if (!selectedShot?.id || !projectId) {
   618→    return { success: true, settingName: 'images', details: 'skipped - missing context' };
   619→  }
   620→  
   621→  // Use inputImages from params if passed array is empty but settings has them
   622→  const effectiveInputImages = (inputImages && inputImages.length > 0) 
   623→    ? inputImages 
   624→    : (settings.inputImages || []);
   625→  
   626→  if (effectiveInputImages.length === 0) {
   627→    return { success: false, settingName: 'images', error: 'No input images available' };
   628→  }
   629→  
   630→  try {
   631→    // Remove existing non-video images (only those with id)
   632→    const imagesToDelete = simpleFilteredImages.filter((img): img is GenerationRow & { id: string } => !!img.id);
   633→
   634→    const deletions = imagesToDelete.map(img => removeImageFromShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   635→      shotId: selectedShot.id,
   636→      shotGenerationId: img.id, // img.id is shot_generations.id - narrowed by filter above
   637→      projectId: projectId,
   638→    }));
   639→    
   640→    if (deletions.length > 0) {
   641→      await Promise.allSettled(deletions);
   642→    }
   643→    
   644→    // Calculate timeline positions from segment_frames_expanded array
   645→    // segment_frames_expanded contains GAPS between successive frames
   646→    // e.g., [65, 37, 21] means: image0=0, image1=0+65=65, image2=65+37=102, image3=102+21=123
   647→    const segmentGaps = settings.segmentFramesExpanded;
   648→    const hasSegmentGaps = Array.isArray(segmentGaps) && segmentGaps.length > 0;
   649→    
   650→    // Calculate cumulative positions from gaps
   651→    let cumulativePositions: number[] = [];
   652→    if (hasSegmentGaps) {
   653→      cumulativePositions = [0]; // First image always at frame 0
   654→      for (let i = 0; i < segmentGaps.length; i++) {
   655→        const prevPosition = cumulativePositions[cumulativePositions.length - 1];
   656→        cumulativePositions.push(prevPosition + segmentGaps[i]);
   657→      }
   658→    }
   659→    
   660→    // Fallback to uniform spacing if no segment_frames_expanded
   661→    const uniformSpacing = settings.frames || 60;
   662→    
   663→    // Look up generation IDs for all input image URLs
   664→    const { data: generationLookup, error: lookupError } = await supabase
   665→      .from('generations')
   666→      .select('id, location, thumbnail_url')
   667→      .in('location', effectiveInputImages);
   668→    
   669→    if (lookupError) {
   670→      console.error('[ApplySettings] ❌ Failed to look up generations by URL:', lookupError);
   671→      return { success: false, settingName: 'images', error: 'Failed to look up generation IDs for input images' };
   672→    }
   673→    
   674→    // Create a map of URL -> generation data for quick lookup
   675→    const urlToGeneration = new Map<string, { id: string; location: string; thumbnail_url: string | null }>();
   676→    (generationLookup || []).forEach(gen => {
   677→      if (gen.location) {
   678→        urlToGeneration.set(gen.location, gen);
   679→      }
   680→    });
   681→    
   682→    // Add input images in order with calculated timeline_frame positions
   683→    const additions = effectiveInputImages.map((url: string, index: number) => {
   684→      // Use cumulative position if available, otherwise fall back to uniform spacing
   685→      const timelineFrame = hasSegmentGaps && index < cumulativePositions.length
   686→        ? cumulativePositions[index]
   687→        : index * uniformSpacing;
   688→      
   689→      // Look up the generation for this URL
   690→      const generation = urlToGeneration.get(url);
   691→      
   692→      if (!generation) {
   693→        return Promise.resolve(); // Skip this image
   694→      }
   695→      
   696→      return addImageToShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   697→        shot_id: selectedShot.id,
   698→        generation_id: generation.id,
   699→        project_id: projectId,
   700→        imageUrl: url,
   701→        thumbUrl: generation.thumbnail_url || url,
   702→        timelineFrame: timelineFrame,
   703→      });
   704→    });
   705→    
   706→    if (additions.length > 0) {
   707→      await Promise.allSettled(additions);
   708→    }
   709→    
   710→    return {
   711→      success: true,
   712→      settingName: 'images',
   713→      details: { removed: imagesToDelete.length, added: effectiveInputImages.length }
   714→    };
   715→  } catch (e) {
   716→    const errorMessage = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
   717→    console.error('[ApplySettings] ❌ Error replacing images:', e);
   718→    return {
   719→      success: false,
   720→      settingName: 'images',
   721→      error: errorMessage
   722→    };
   723→  }
   724→};
   725→
   726→

   209→      console.warn(`[GenHandler] Source generation ${basedOnId} not found, skipping loop variant`);
   210→    }
   211→  }
   212→
   213→  return result;
   214→}
   215→
   216→// ===== HANDLER: VARIANT ON CHILD =====
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Creates a variant on an existing child generation (for individual segment regeneration)
   220→ * Used by: individual_travel_segment (when child_generation_id is present)
   221→ */
   222→export async function handleVariantOnChild(ctx: HandlerContext): Promise<any | null> {
   223→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, logger, childGenerationId } = ctx;
   224→
   225→  if (!childGenerationId) {
   226→    console.log(`[GenHandler] No child_generation_id, falling back to child_generation behavior`);
   227→    return null; // Fall back to child_generation behavior
   228→  }
   229→
   230→  const childGenId = childGenerationId;
   231→
   232→  console.log(`[GenHandler] individual_travel_segment - creating variant for child generation ${childGenId}`);
   233→  logger?.info("individual_travel_segment with child_generation_id", {
   234→    task_id: taskId,
   235→    child_generation_id: childGenId,
   236→    action: "create_variant_on_existing_child"
   237→  });
   238→
   239→  const { data: childGen, error: fetchError } = await supabase
   240→    .from('generations')
   241→    .select('*')
   242→    .eq('id', childGenId)
   243→    .single();
   244→
   245→  if (fetchError || !childGen) {
   246→    console.error(`[GenHandler] Error fetching child generation ${childGenId}:`, fetchError);
   247→    return null;
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  // Extract pair_shot_generation_id from nested locations if not at top level
   251→  const segmentIndex = taskData.params?.segment_index ?? 0;
   252→  const orchPairIds = taskData.params?.orchestrator_details?.pair_shot_generation_ids;
   253→  const pairShotGenerationId = taskData.params?.pair_shot_generation_id ||
   254→                                taskData.params?.individual_segment_params?.pair_shot_generation_id ||
   255→                                (Array.isArray(orchPairIds) && orchPairIds[segmentIndex]);
   256→
   257→  const variantParams = {
   258→    ...taskData.params,
   259→    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   260→    source_task_id: taskId,
   261→    created_from: 'individual_segment_regeneration',
   262→    ...(pairShotGenerationId && { pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenerationId }),
   263→  };
   264→
   265→  // Respect make_primary_variant flag from UI (defaults to true for backward compatibility)
   266→  const makePrimary = taskData.params?.make_primary_variant ?? true;
   267→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Creating variant with isPrimary=${makePrimary}`);
   268→
   269→  // Always check for single-segment case (independent of makePrimary flag)
   270→  // This determines if we should propagate to the parent generation
   271→  const singleSegmentViewedAt = await getChildVariantViewedAt(supabase, {
   272→    taskParams: taskData.params,
   273→    childGeneration: childGen,
   274→  });
   275→  const isSingleSegmentChild = singleSegmentViewedAt !== null;
   276→
   277→  // For the child variant, only auto-view if makePrimary is true
   278→  const childViewedAt = makePrimary ? singleSegmentViewedAt : null;
   279→
   280→  const variantType = taskData.variant_type || VARIANT_TYPE_DEFAULT;
   281→
   282→  await createVariant(
   283→    supabase,
   284→    childGen.id,
   285→    publicUrl,
   286→    thumbnailUrl,
   287→    variantParams,
   288→    makePrimary,
   289→    variantType,
   290→    null,
   291→    childViewedAt
   292→  );
   293→
   294→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Successfully created variant for child generation ${childGenId}${childViewedAt ? ' (auto-viewed)' : ''}${isSingleSegmentChild ? ' (single-segment)' : ''}`);
   295→
   296→  // SINGLE-SEGMENT PROPAGATION: If this child is the only child of its parent,
   297→  // also create a variant on the parent so the main generation updates automatically
   298→  if (isSingleSegmentChild && childGen.parent_generation_id) {
   299→    // Check if parent already has variants - only make primary if it's the first
   300→    const { count: existingParentVariants } = await supabase
   301→      .from('generation_variants')
   302→      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   303→      .eq('generation_id', childGen.parent_generation_id);
   304→
   305→    const isFirstParentVariant = (existingParentVariants || 0) === 0;
   306→    const makeParentPrimary = isFirstParentVariant || makePrimary;
   307→
   308→    console.log(`[GenHandler] Single-segment child - also creating variant on parent ${childGen.parent_generation_id} (isFirst=${isFirstParentVariant}, makePrimary=${makeParentPrimary})`);
   309→    logger?.info("Single-segment propagation to parent", {
   310→      task_id: taskId,
   311→      child_generation_id: childGenId,
   312→      parent_generation_id: childGen.parent_generation_id,
   313→      action: "propagate_to_parent",
   314→      is_first_parent_variant: isFirstParentVariant,
   315→      make_primary: makeParentPrimary
   316→    });
   317→
   318→    await createVariant(
   319→      supabase,
   320→      childGen.parent_generation_id,
   321→      publicUrl,
   322→      thumbnailUrl,
   323→      {
   324→        ...variantParams,
   325→        propagated_from_child: childGenId,
   326→        created_from: 'single_segment_propagation',
   327→      },
   328→      makeParentPrimary,
   329→      variantType, // Use same variant_type as child
   330→      null
   331→    );
   332→    console.log(`[GenHandler] Successfully propagated to parent generation`);
   333→  }
   334→
   335→  await supabase.from('tasks').update({ generation_created: true }).eq('id', taskId);
   336→  return childGen;
   337→}
   338→
   339→// ===== HANDLER: STANDALONE GENERATION =====
   340→
   341→/**
   342→ * Creates an independent generation (for regular tasks)
   343→ * Used by: single_image, wan_2_2_i2v, image_inpaint, etc.
   344→ */
   345→export async function handleStandaloneGeneration(ctx: HandlerContext): Promise<any> {
   346→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, logger } = ctx;
   347→
   348→  const { shotId, addInPosition } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   349→
   350→  // Validate shot exists
   351→  if (shotId) {
   352→    const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
   353→    if (uuidRegex.test(shotId)) {
   354→      const { data: shotData, error: shotError } = await supabase.from('shots').select('id').eq('id', shotId).single();
   355→      if (shotError || !shotData) {
   356→        console.log(`[GenHandler] Shot ${shotId} does not exist, proceeding without shot link`);
   357→      }
   358→    }
   359→  }
   360→
   361→  const generationType = taskData.content_type || 'image';
   362→  const generationParams = buildGenerationParams(
   363→    taskData.params, taskData.tool_type, generationType, shotId, thumbnailUrl || undefined, taskId
   364→  );
   365→  const newGenerationId = crypto.randomUUID();
   366→
   367→  const generationName = taskData.params?.generation_name ||
   368→    taskData.params?.orchestrator_details?.generation_name ||
   369→    taskData.params?.full_orchestrator_payload?.generation_name;
   370→
   371→  // Find based_on
   372→  let basedOnGenerationId: string | null = extractBasedOn(taskData.params);
   373→  if (basedOnGenerationId) {
   374→    const { data: basedOnGen, error: basedOnError } = await supabase
   375→      .from('generations')
   376→      .select('id')
   377→      .eq('id', basedOnGenerationId)
   378→      .maybeSingle();
   379→
   380→    if (basedOnError || !basedOnGen) {
   381→      console.warn(`[GenHandler] based_on generation ${basedOnGenerationId} not found, clearing reference`);
   382→      basedOnGenerationId = null;
   383→    }
   384→  }
   385→  if (!basedOnGenerationId) {
   386→    const sourceImageUrl = taskData.params?.image;
   387→    if (sourceImageUrl) {
   388→      basedOnGenerationId = await findSourceGenerationByImageUrl(supabase, sourceImageUrl);
   389→    }
   390→  }
   391→
   392→  logger?.info("Creating standalone generation", {
   393→    task_id: taskId,
   394→    generation_id: newGenerationId,
   395→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   396→    shot_id: shotId,
   397→    generation_type: generationType,
   398→  });
   399→
   400→  const generationRecord: Record<string, any> = {
   401→    id: newGenerationId,
   402→    tasks: [taskId],
   403→    params: generationParams,
   404→    type: generationType,
   405→    project_id: taskData.project_id,
   406→    name: generationName,
   407→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   408→    parent_generation_id: null,
   409→    is_child: false,
   410→    child_order: null,
   411→    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   412→  };
   413→
   414→  const newGeneration = await insertGeneration(supabase, generationRecord);
   415→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Created standalone generation ${newGeneration.id}`);
   416→
   417→  // Create "original" variant
   418→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Creating original variant`);
   419→  await createVariant(
   420→    supabase, newGeneration.id, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl,
   421→    { ...generationParams, source_task_id: taskId, created_from: 'generation_original' },
   422→    true, 'original', null, null
   423→  );
   424→
   425→  // Link to shot if applicable
   426→  if (shotId) {
   427→    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, newGeneration.id, addInPosition);
   428→  }
   429→
   430→  await supabase.from('tasks').update({ generation_created: true }).eq('id', taskId);
   431→
   432→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Standalone generation creation complete`);
   433→  return newGeneration;
   434→}
   435→

   324→  }
   325→
   326→  // ── Extract image URLs and IDs from fetched data ────────────────────────
   327→  const filteredForUrls = filterImageShotGenerations(allShotGenerations)
   328→    .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
   329→
   330→  const freshImagesWithIds = filteredForUrls.map(shotGen => ({
   331→    location: shotGen.generation?.location,
   332→    generationId: shotGen.generation?.id || shotGen.generation_id,
   333→    primaryVariantId: shotGen.generation?.primary_variant_id || undefined,
   334→    shotGenerationId: shotGen.id,
   335→  })).filter(item => Boolean(item.location));
   336→
   337→  const absoluteImageUrls = freshImagesWithIds
   338→    .map(item => getDisplayUrl(item.location))
   339→    .filter((url): url is string => Boolean(url) && url !== '/placeholder.svg');
   340→
   341→  const filteredImages = freshImagesWithIds.filter(item => {
   342→    const url = getDisplayUrl(item.location);
   343→    return Boolean(url) && url !== '/placeholder.svg';
   344→  });

   346→  const imageGenerationIds = filteredImages
   347→    .map(item => item.generationId)
   348→    .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id));

   351→  const imageVariantIds = filteredImages
   352→    .map(item => item.primaryVariantId)

   360→
   361→  // ── Per-pair overrides (timeline vs batch) ──────────────────────────────
   362→  let basePrompts: string[];
   363→  let segmentFrames: number[];
   364→  let frameOverlap: number[];
   365→  let negativePrompts: string[];
   366→  let enhancedPromptsArray: string[] = [];
   367→  let pairPhaseConfigsArray: (PhaseConfig | null)[] = [];

   370→
   371→  if (generationMode === 'timeline') {
   372→    // ── TIMELINE MODE: Extract per-pair overrides from fetched data ──────
   373→    const pairPrompts: Record<number, { prompt: string; negativePrompt: string }> = {};
   374→    const enhancedPrompts: Record<number, string> = {};
   375→    const pairPhaseConfigsOverrides: Record<number, PhaseConfig> = {};
   376→    const pairLorasOverrides: Record<number, Array<{ path: string; strength: number }>> = {};
   377→    const pairMotionSettingsOverrides: Record<number, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
   378→    const pairNumFramesOverrides: Record<number, number> = {};
   379→
   380→    // Reuse the same data already fetched — filter to match absoluteImageUrls exactly
   381→    const filteredShotGenerations = filterImageShotGenerations(allShotGenerations);
   382→
   383→    // Build sorted positions for frame gap calculation
   384→    const sortedPositions = filteredShotGenerations
   385→      .filter(shotGen => shotGen.timeline_frame != null && shotGen.timeline_frame >= 0)
   386→      .map(shotGen => ({
   387→        id: getGenerationId(shotGen),
   388→        pos: shotGen.timeline_frame!,
   389→      }))
   390→      .sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos);
   391→
   392→    // Extract per-pair overrides from filtered data (indexes match actual image pairs)
   393→    for (let i = 0; i < filteredShotGenerations.length - 1; i++) {
   394→      const firstItem = filteredShotGenerations[i];
   395→      const metadata = firstItem.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   396→      const { overrides, enhancedPrompt, legacyOverrides } = extractPairOverrides(metadata);
   397→
   398→      // Prompts
   399→      if (overrides.prompt || overrides.negativePrompt) {

   401→          prompt: overrides.prompt || '',
   402→          negativePrompt: overrides.negativePrompt || '',
   403→        };
   404→      }
   405→
   406→      if (enhancedPrompt) {
   407→        enhancedPrompts[i] = enhancedPrompt;
   408→      }
   409→
   410→      // Phase config (ignore stale phase_config when motion_mode is 'basic')
   411→      const pairMotionMode = overrides.motionMode || legacyOverrides?.motion_mode;
   412→      const isBasicMode = pairMotionMode === 'basic';
   413→
   414→      if (!isBasicMode) {

   417→        } else if (legacyOverrides?.phase_config) {

   419→        }
   420→      }
   421→
   422→      // LoRAs
   423→      if (overrides.loras && overrides.loras.length > 0) {
   424→        pairLorasOverrides[i] = overrides.loras.map(lora => ({
   425→          path: lora.path,
   426→          strength: lora.strength,
   427→        }));
   428→      } else if (legacyOverrides?.additional_loras && Object.keys(legacyOverrides.additional_loras).length > 0) {
   429→        pairLorasOverrides[i] = Object.entries(legacyOverrides.additional_loras).map(([path, strength]) => ({
   430→          path,
   431→          strength: typeof strength === 'number' ? strength : 1.0,
   432→        }));
   433→      }
   434→
   435→      // Motion and structure settings
   436→      const hasMotionOverrides = overrides.motionMode !== undefined || overrides.amountOfMotion !== undefined;
   437→      const hasStructureOverrides = overrides.structureMotionStrength !== undefined ||
   438→                                    overrides.structureTreatment !== undefined ||
   439→                                    overrides.structureUni3cEndPercent !== undefined;
   440→
   441→      if (hasMotionOverrides || hasStructureOverrides) {
   442→        pairMotionSettingsOverrides[i] = {
   443→          ...(overrides.amountOfMotion !== undefined && { amount_of_motion: overrides.amountOfMotion / 100 }),
   444→          ...(overrides.motionMode !== undefined && { motion_mode: overrides.motionMode }),
   445→          ...(overrides.structureMotionStrength !== undefined && { structure_motion_strength: overrides.structureMotionStrength }),
   446→          ...(overrides.structureTreatment !== undefined && { structure_treatment: overrides.structureTreatment }),
   447→          ...(overrides.structureUni3cEndPercent !== undefined && { uni3c_end_percent: overrides.structureUni3cEndPercent }),
   448→        };
   449→      } else if (legacyOverrides?.amount_of_motion !== undefined || legacyOverrides?.motion_mode !== undefined) {

   462→    // Calculate frame gaps from sorted positions
   463→    const frameGaps: number[] = [];

   481→    frameOverlap = frameGaps.length > 0 ? frameGaps.map(() => 10) : [10];

   487→        })

   490→    enhancedPromptsArray = frameGaps.length > 0
   491→      ? frameGaps.map((_, index) => enhancedPrompts[index] || '')

   493→
   494→    pairPhaseConfigsArray = frameGaps.length > 0
   495→      ? frameGaps.map((_, index) => {

   499→      : [];

   501→    pairLorasArray = frameGaps.length > 0
   502→      ? frameGaps.map((_, index) => pairLorasOverrides[index] || null)
   503→      : [];
   504→
   505→    pairMotionSettingsArray = frameGaps.length > 0
   506→      ? frameGaps.map((_, index) => pairMotionSettingsOverrides[index] || null)
   507→      : [];
   508→  } else {
   509→    // ── BATCH MODE: Uniform settings for all pairs ──────────────────────
   510→    const numPairs = Math.max(0, absoluteImageUrls.length - 1);
   511→
   512→    basePrompts = numPairs > 0 ? Array(numPairs).fill('') : [''];
   513→    negativePrompts = numPairs > 0 ? Array(numPairs).fill(defaultNegativePrompt) : [defaultNegativePrompt];
   514→    segmentFrames = numPairs > 0 ? Array(numPairs).fill(batchVideoFrames) : [batchVideoFrames];
   515→    frameOverlap = numPairs > 0 ? Array(numPairs).fill(10) : [10];
   516→    pairPhaseConfigsArray = numPairs > 0 ? Array(numPairs).fill(null) : [];
   517→    pairLorasArray = numPairs > 0 ? Array(numPairs).fill(null) : [];
   518→    pairMotionSettingsArray = numPairs > 0 ? Array(numPairs).fill(null) : [];
   519→    enhancedPromptsArray = numPairs > 0 ? Array(numPairs).fill(null) : [];

   521→
   522→  // ── Model and phase config determination ────────────────────────────────
   523→  let actualModelName: string;
   524→  let effectivePhaseConfig: PhaseConfig;

   526→  const userLorasForPhaseConfig = (selectedLoras || []).map(l => ({
   527→    path: l.path,

    28→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,

    30→
    31→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
    32→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
    33→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: any): { cost: number; breakdown: any } {
    34→  let totalCost = 0;
    35→  const breakdown: any = {};
    36→
    37→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
    38→  const result = taskParams?.result || taskParams;
    39→
    40→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
    41→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
    42→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
    43→    totalCost += filmCost;
    44→    breakdown.interpolation = {
    45→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
    46→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
    47→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
    48→    };
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
    52→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
    53→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
    54→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
    55→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
    56→    breakdown.upscale = {
    57→      output_width: result.output_width,
    58→      output_height: result.output_height,
    59→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
    60→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
    61→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
    62→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
    63→    };
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  return {
    67→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
    68→    breakdown,
    69→  };
    70→}

    72→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
    73→function calculateTaskCost(
    74→  taskType: string,
    75→  billingType: string,
    76→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
    77→  unitCost: number,
    78→  durationSeconds: number,
    79→  costFactors: any,

    81→): { cost: number; breakdown?: any } {

    84→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);

    86→
    87→  let totalCost;

    89→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;

    92→  }
    93→
    94→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
    95→  if (costFactors) {
    96→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
    97→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
    98→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
    99→    }
   100→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   101→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   102→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   103→      } else {

   155→    const { task_id } = await req.json();
   156→
   157→    if (!task_id) {
   158→      logger.error("Missing task_id in request");
   159→      await logger.flush();
   160→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'task_id is required' }, 400);
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    // Set task_id for all subsequent logs
   164→    logger.setDefaultTaskId(task_id);
   165→    logger.info("Calculating task cost", { task_id });
   166→
   167→    // Get task details
   168→    const { data: task, error: taskError } = await supabaseAdmin
   169→      .from('tasks')
   170→      .select(`
   171→        id,
   172→        task_type,
   173→        params,
   174→        status,
   175→        generation_started_at,
   176→        generation_processed_at,
   177→        project_id,
   178→        projects(user_id)
   179→      `)
   180→      .eq('id', task_id)
   181→      .single();
   182→
   183→    if (taskError || !task) {
   184→      logger.error("Task not found", { error: taskError?.message });
   185→      await logger.flush();
   186→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Task not found' }, 404);
   187→    }
   188→
   189→    logger.debug("Task found", { 
   190→      task_type: task.task_type, 
   191→      status: task.status,
   192→      has_timestamps: !!(task.generation_started_at && task.generation_processed_at)
   193→    });
   194→
   195→    // Check if task has both start and end times
   196→    if (!task.generation_started_at || !task.generation_processed_at) {
   197→      logger.error("Missing timestamps", { 
   198→        has_started_at: !!task.generation_started_at, 
   199→        has_processed_at: !!task.generation_processed_at 
   200→      });
   201→      await logger.flush();
   202→      return jsonResponse({
   203→        error: 'Task must have both generation_started_at and generation_processed_at timestamps'
   204→      }, 400);
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    // Check if task is a sub-task of an orchestrator - skip billing if so (parent will be billed)
   208→    // Uses shared detection: checks all param paths, validates UUID, guards against self-reference
   209→    const subTaskOrchestratorId = getSubTaskOrchestratorId(task.params, task.id);
   210→
   211→    if (subTaskOrchestratorId) {
   212→      logger.info("Skipping cost calculation (sub-task)", {
   213→        orchestrator_task_id: subTaskOrchestratorId
   214→      });
   215→      await logger.flush();
   216→      return jsonResponse({
   217→        success: true,
   218→        skipped: true,
   219→        reason: 'Task is sub-task of orchestrator, parent task will be billed',
   220→        orchestrator_task_id: subTaskOrchestratorId,
   221→        task_id: task.id
   222→      });
   223→    }
   224→
   225→    // Check if this is an orchestrator task - calculate cost based on sub-task durations
   226→    const { data: subTasks, error: subTasksError } = await supabaseAdmin
   227→      .from('tasks')
   228→      .select(`
   229→        id,
   230→        generation_started_at,
   231→        generation_processed_at,
   232→        status
   233→      `)
   234→      .or(buildSubTaskFilter(task_id))
   235→      .eq('status', 'Complete');
   236→
   237→    let durationSeconds;
   238→    if (subTasks && subTasks.length > 0) {
   239→      // This is an orchestrator task with sub-tasks - sum their durations
   240→      logger.info("Orchestrator task detected", { sub_task_count: subTasks.length });
   241→
   242→      let totalSubTaskDuration = 0;
   243→      for (const subTask of subTasks) {
   244→        if (subTask.generation_started_at && subTask.generation_processed_at) {
   245→          const subStartTime = new Date(subTask.generation_started_at);
   246→          const subEndTime = new Date(subTask.generation_processed_at);
   247→          const subDuration = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((subEndTime.getTime() - subStartTime.getTime()) / 1000));
   248→          totalSubTaskDuration += subDuration;
   249→        }
   250→      }
   251→
   252→      durationSeconds = totalSubTaskDuration;
   253→      logger.debug("Orchestrator duration calculated", { 
   254→        sub_task_count: subTasks.length, 
   255→        total_duration_seconds: durationSeconds 
   256→      });
   257→    } else {
   258→      // Regular task - use its own duration
   259→      const startTime = new Date(task.generation_started_at);
   260→      const endTime = new Date(task.generation_processed_at);
   261→      durationSeconds = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((endTime.getTime() - startTime.getTime()) / 1000));
   262→    }
   263→
   264→    // Idempotency: avoid double-billing if this function is called multiple times for the same task.
   265→    // The credits ledger is intended to be immutable, so we should skip if a spend entry already exists.
   266→    const { data: existingSpendEntries, error: existingSpendError } = await supabaseAdmin
   267→      .from('credits_ledger')
   268→      .select('id, amount, created_at')
   269→      .eq('task_id', task.id)
   270→      .eq('type', 'spend')
   271→      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
   272→      .limit(1);
   273→
   274→    if (existingSpendError) {
   275→      logger.error("Failed to check existing credit ledger entries", { error: existingSpendError.message });
   276→      await logger.flush();
   277→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Failed to check existing cost records' }, 500);
   278→    }
   279→
   280→    if (existingSpendEntries && existingSpendEntries.length > 0) {
   281→      const existing = existingSpendEntries[0];
   282→      logger.info("Cost already recorded - skipping", {
   283→        ledger_id: existing.id,
   284→        existing_amount: existing.amount
   285→      });
   286→      await logger.flush();
   287→      return jsonResponse({
   288→        success: true,
   289→        skipped: true,
   290→        reason: 'Cost already recorded for this task',
   291→        task_id: task.id,
   292→        ledger_id: existing.id,
   293→        existing_amount: existing.amount
   294→      });
   295→    }
   296→
   297→    // Get task type configuration
   298→    const { data: taskType, error: taskTypeError } = await supabaseAdmin
   299→      .from('task_types')
   300→      .select('*')
   301→      .eq('name', task.task_type)
   302→      .eq('is_active', true)
   303→      .single();
   304→
   305→    if (taskTypeError || !taskType) {
   306→      logger.error("No task type config found, using defaults", { task_type: task.task_type });
   307→
   308→      // Use default cost if no config found — must match DB-level get_task_cost() default of 0.0278
   309→      const defaultCostPerSecond = 0.0278;
   310→      const cost = defaultCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   311→
   312→      const { error: ledgerError } = await supabaseAdmin.from('credits_ledger').insert({
   313→        user_id: (task as any).projects.user_id,
   314→        task_id: task.id,
   315→        amount: -cost,
   316→        type: 'spend',
   317→        metadata: {
   318→          task_type: task.task_type,
   319→          duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
   320→          base_cost_per_second: defaultCostPerSecond,
   321→          billing_type: 'per_second',
   322→          calculated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   323→          cost_fallback_used: true,
   324→          note: 'Default cost used - no task type configuration found'
   325→        }
   326→      });
   327→
   328→      if (ledgerError) {
   329→        logger.error("Failed to insert into credit ledger (default)", { error: ledgerError.message });
   330→        await logger.flush();
   331→        return jsonResponse({ error: 'Failed to record cost in ledger' }, 500);
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      logger.info("Cost calculated (default rates)", { 
   335→        cost,
   336→        duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
   337→        billing_type: 'per_second'
   338→      });
   339→      await logger.flush();
   340→
   341→      return jsonResponse({
   342→        success: true,
   343→        cost: cost,
   344→        duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
   345→        base_cost_per_second: defaultCostPerSecond,
   346→        billing_type: 'per_second',
   347→        note: 'Default cost used - no task type configuration found'
   348→      });
   349→    }
   350→
   351→    // Calculate cost based on task type configuration
   352→    const costResult = calculateTaskCost(
   353→      task.task_type,
   354→      taskType.billing_type,
   355→      taskType.base_cost_per_second,
   356→      taskType.unit_cost,
   357→      durationSeconds,
   358→      taskType.cost_factors,
   359→      task.params
   360→    );
   361→    const cost = costResult.cost;
   362→    const costBreakdown = costResult.breakdown;
   363→
   364→    // Validate cost calculation
   365→    if (isNaN(cost) || cost < 0) {
   366→      logger.error("Invalid cost calculated", {
   367→        cost,
   368→        billing_type: taskType.billing_type,
   369→        base_cost_per_second: taskType.base_cost_per_second,
   370→        unit_cost: taskType.unit_cost,
   371→        duration: durationSeconds,
   372→        breakdown: costBreakdown
   373→      });
   374→      await logger.flush();
   375→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Invalid cost calculation' }, 500);
   376→    }
   377→
   378→    // Ensure user exists before inserting credit ledger entry
   379→    const { data: user, error: userError } = await supabaseAdmin
   380→      .from('users')
   381→      .select('id')
   382→      .eq('id', (task as any).projects.user_id)
   383→      .single();
   384→
   385→    if (userError || !user) {
   386→      logger.error("User not found for credit ledger", { 
   387→        user_id: (task as any).projects.user_id, 
   388→        error: userError?.message 
   389→      });
   390→      await logger.flush();
   391→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'User not found for credit calculation' }, 400);
   392→    }
   393→
   394→    // Insert cost into credit ledger
   395→    const { error: ledgerError } = await supabaseAdmin.from('credits_ledger').insert({
   396→      user_id: (task as any).projects.user_id,
   397→      task_id: task.id,
   398→      amount: -cost,
   399→      type: 'spend',
   400→      metadata: {
   401→        task_type: task.task_type,
   402→        billing_type: taskType.billing_type,
   403→        duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
   404→        base_cost_per_second: taskType.base_cost_per_second,
   405→        unit_cost: taskType.unit_cost,
   406→        cost_factors: taskType.cost_factors,
   407→        task_params: task.params,
   408→        calculated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   409→        task_type_id: taskType.id,
   410→        // Include breakdown for compound pricing (e.g., video_enhance)
   411→        ...(costBreakdown ? { cost_breakdown: costBreakdown } : {})
   412→      }
   413→    });
   414→
   415→    if (ledgerError) {
   416→      logger.error("Failed to insert into credit ledger", { 
   417→        error: ledgerError.message,
   418→        user_id: (task as any).projects.user_id,
   419→        cost
   420→      });
   421→      await logger.flush();
   422→      return jsonResponse({ error: `Failed to record cost in ledger: ${ledgerError.message}` }, 500);
   423→    }
   424→
   425→    logger.info("Cost calculated and recorded", {
   426→      cost,
   427→      billing_type: taskType.billing_type,
   428→      duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
   429→      user_id: (task as any).projects.user_id,
   430→      ...(costBreakdown ? { breakdown: costBreakdown } : {})
   431→    });
   432→    await logger.flush();
   433→
   434→    return jsonResponse({
   435→      success: true,
   436→      cost: cost,
   437→      billing_type: taskType.billing_type,
   438→      duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
   439→      base_cost_per_second: taskType.base_cost_per_second,
   440→      unit_cost: taskType.unit_cost,
   441→      cost_factors: taskType.cost_factors,
   442→      task_type: task.task_type,
   443→      task_id: task.id,
   444→      // Include breakdown for compound pricing (e.g., video_enhance)
   445→      ...(costBreakdown ? { cost_breakdown: costBreakdown } : {})
   446→    });
   447→
   448→  } catch (error: any) {
   449→    logger.critical("Unexpected error", { error: error?.message, stack: error?.stack?.substring(0, 500) });
   450→    await logger.flush();
   451→    return jsonResponse({ error: error?.message || 'Unknown error occurred' }, 500);

1→/**
     2→ * useModeReadiness - Manages mode readiness state and transitions
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles the complex logic for determining when the editor is ready to display,
     5→ * including settings loading timeouts, mobile mode overrides, and error recovery.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
     9→import { ShotEditorActions } from '../state';
    10→import { Shot, GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';
    11→
    12→interface UseModeReadinessProps {
    13→  selectedShot: Shot | undefined;
    14→  contextImages: GenerationRow[];
    15→  settingsLoading: boolean;
    16→  isShotUISettingsLoading: boolean;
    17→  isShotLoraSettingsLoading: boolean;
    18→  isPhone: boolean;
    19→  isMobile: boolean;
    20→  generationMode: 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair';
    21→  state: {
    22→    settingsError: string | null;
    23→    isModeReady: boolean;
    24→  };
    25→  actions: ShotEditorActions;
    26→  onGenerationModeChange?: (mode: 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair') => void;
    27→}
    28→
    29→export function useModeReadiness({
    30→  selectedShot,
    31→  contextImages,
    32→  settingsLoading,
    33→  isShotUISettingsLoading,
    34→  isShotLoraSettingsLoading,
    35→  isPhone,
    36→  isMobile,
    37→  generationMode,
    38→  state,
    39→  actions,
    40→}: UseModeReadinessProps): void {
    41→  // Track previous shot ID for change detection
    42→  const prevShotIdRef = useRef<string | undefined>(undefined);
    43→
    44→  // Track if we've applied the mobile mode override
    45→  const mobileOverrideAppliedRef = useRef(false);
    46→
    47→  // Reset mobile override flag when shot changes
    48→  useEffect(() => {
    49→    mobileOverrideAppliedRef.current = false;
    50→  }, [selectedShot?.id]);
    51→
    52→  // Enhanced settings loading timeout with mobile-specific recovery
    53→  useEffect(() => {
    54→    const anySettingsLoading = settingsLoading || isShotUISettingsLoading || isShotLoraSettingsLoading;
    55→
    56→    if (!anySettingsLoading) {
    57→      // Reset any existing error once all settings loading completes successfully
    58→      actions.setSettingsError(null);
    59→      return;
    60→    }
    61→
    62→    // Conservative timeouts to handle poor network conditions gracefully
    63→    const timeoutMs = isMobile ? 8000 : 6000;
    64→
    65→    const fallbackTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    66→
    67→      // Force recovery - prevents endless loading states
    68→      actions.setSettingsError(null);
    69→      actions.setModeReady(true);
    70→
    71→      // Mobile-specific: dispatch event to notify other components
    72→      if (isMobile) {
    73→        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shotEditorRecovery', {
    74→          detail: { shotId: selectedShot?.id, reason: 'settings_timeout' }
    75→        }));
    76→      }
    77→    }, timeoutMs);
    78→
    79→    return () => clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
    80→  }, [settingsLoading, isShotUISettingsLoading, isShotLoraSettingsLoading, actions, isMobile, selectedShot?.id]);
    81→
    82→  // Reset mode readiness when shot changes
    83→  // Only reset if we don't have context images yet
    84→  useEffect(() => {
    85→    const shotId = selectedShot?.id;
    86→    const shotIdChanged = shotId !== prevShotIdRef.current;
    87→
    88→    if (shotId && shotIdChanged) {
    89→      prevShotIdRef.current = shotId;
    90→      const hasContextImages = contextImages.length > 0;
    91→      if (hasContextImages) {
    92→        // We have images - stay ready, let settings update in background
    93→        actions.setModeReady(true);
    94→      } else {
    95→        // No images yet - reset to loading state
    96→        actions.setModeReady(false);
    97→      }
    98→    }
    99→    // Note: We intentionally DON'T include contextImages.length in deps
   100→    // to prevent mode flipping when cache updates temporarily clear images
   101→  }, [selectedShot?.id, actions]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
   102→
   103→  // Compute readiness state
   104→  const readinessState = useMemo(() => ({
   105→    hasImageData: contextImages.length > 0,
   106→    criticalSettingsReady: !settingsLoading,
   107→    modeCorrect: !isPhone || generationMode !== 'timeline',
   108→    hasError: !!state.settingsError,
   109→    shotId: selectedShot?.id,
   110→    isReady: state.isModeReady
   111→  }), [contextImages.length, settingsLoading, isPhone, generationMode, state.settingsError, selectedShot?.id, state.isModeReady]);
   112→
   113→  // Handle mode setup and readiness transitions
   114→  useEffect(() => {
   115→    const { hasImageData, criticalSettingsReady, modeCorrect, hasError, isReady } = readinessState;
   116→
   117→    // Skip if already ready
   118→    if (isReady) return;
   119→
   120→    // Handle mobile mode correction - LOCAL OVERRIDE ONLY, don't save to database
   121→    if (!modeCorrect && !mobileOverrideAppliedRef.current) {
   122→      mobileOverrideAppliedRef.current = true;
   123→      actions.setModeReady(true);
   124→      return;
   125→    }
   126→
   127→    // Handle error recovery
   128→    if (hasError) {
   129→      actions.setModeReady(true);
   130→      return;
   131→    }
   132→
   133→    // PERFORMANCE BOOST: Allow ready state if we have images + critical settings
   134→    if (hasImageData && criticalSettingsReady) {
   135→      actions.setModeReady(true);
   136→      return;
   137→    }
   138→
   139→    // For shots without images, wait for all settings
   140→    if (!hasImageData && !settingsLoading && !isShotUISettingsLoading && !isShotLoraSettingsLoading) {
   141→      actions.setModeReady(true);
   142→    }
   143→  }, [readinessState, actions, selectedShot?.id, contextImages.length, isShotUISettingsLoading, isShotLoraSettingsLoading, settingsLoading]);
   144→}
   145→

   135→ */
   136→export function useProjectCRUD({
   137→  selectedProjectId,
   138→  onProjectsLoaded,
   139→  onProjectCreated,
   140→  onProjectDeleted,
   141→  updateUserSettings,
   142→}: UseProjectCRUDOptions) {
   143→  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);
   144→  const [isLoadingProjects, setIsLoadingProjects] = useState(true);
   145→  const [isCreatingProject, setIsCreatingProject] = useState(false);
   146→  const [isUpdatingProject, setIsUpdatingProject] = useState(false);
   147→  const [isDeletingProject, setIsDeletingProject] = useState(false);
   148→
   149→  const fetchProjects = useCallback(async () => {
   150→    try {
   151→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   152→      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   153→
   154→      await ensureUserRecord(user.id);
   155→
   156→      const { data: projectsData, error } = await supabase
   157→        .from('projects')
   158→        .select('*')
   159→        .eq('user_id', user.id)
   160→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
   161→
   162→      if (error) throw error;
   163→
   164→      if (!projectsData || projectsData.length === 0) {
   165→        const { data: newProject, error: createError } = await supabase
   166→          .from('projects')
   167→          .insert({
   168→            name: 'Sample Project',
   169→            user_id: user.id,
   170→            aspect_ratio: '16:9',
   171→          })
   172→          .select()
   173→          .single();
   174→
   175→        if (createError) throw createError;
   176→
   177→        await createDefaultShot(newProject.id, undefined, true);
   178→
   179→        const mappedProject = mapDbProjectToProject(newProject);
   180→        setProjects([mappedProject]);
   181→        onProjectsLoaded([mappedProject], true);
   182→      } else {
   183→        const mappedProjects = projectsData.map(mapDbProjectToProject);
   184→        setProjects(mappedProjects);
   185→        onProjectsLoaded(mappedProjects, false);
   186→      }
   187→    } catch (error: unknown) {
   188→      handleError(error, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to load projects' });
   189→      setProjects([]);
   190→    } finally {
   191→      setIsLoadingProjects(false);
   192→    }
   193→  }, [onProjectsLoaded]);
   194→
   195→  const addNewProject = useCallback(async (projectData: { name: string; aspectRatio: string }) => {
   196→    if (!projectData.name.trim()) {
   197→      toast.error("Project name cannot be empty.");
   198→      return null;
   199→    }
   200→    if (!projectData.aspectRatio) {
   201→      toast.error("Aspect ratio cannot be empty.");
   202→      return null;
   203→    }
   204→    setIsCreatingProject(true);
   205→    try {
   206→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   207→      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   208→
   209→      await ensureUserRecord(user.id);
   210→
   211→      const settingsToInherit = selectedProjectId
   212→        ? await fetchInheritableProjectSettings(selectedProjectId)
   213→        : {};
   214→
   215→      const { data: newProject, error } = await supabase
   216→        .from('projects')
   217→        .insert({
   218→          name: projectData.name,
   219→          user_id: user.id,
   220→          aspect_ratio: projectData.aspectRatio,
   221→          settings: settingsToInherit,
   222→        })
   223→        .select()
   224→        .single();
   225→
   226→      if (error) throw error;
   227→
   228→      const shotSettingsToInherit = selectedProjectId
   229→        ? await buildShotSettingsForNewProject(selectedProjectId, settingsToInherit)
   230→        : {};
   231→
   232→      await createDefaultShot(newProject.id, shotSettingsToInherit);
   233→
   234→      const mappedProject = mapDbProjectToProject(newProject);
   235→      setProjects(prevProjects => sortProjectsByCreatedAt([...prevProjects, mappedProject]));
   236→      onProjectCreated(mappedProject);
   237→
   238→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: mappedProject.id });
   239→
   240→      return mappedProject;
   241→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   242→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to create project' });
   243→      return null;
   244→    } finally {
   245→      setIsCreatingProject(false);
   246→    }
   247→  }, [selectedProjectId, onProjectCreated, updateUserSettings]);
   248→
   249→  const updateProject = useCallback(async (projectId: string, updates: ProjectUpdate): Promise<boolean> => {
   250→    if (!updates.name?.trim() && !updates.aspectRatio) {
   251→      toast.error("No changes to save.");
   252→      return false;
   253→    }
   254→    setIsUpdatingProject(true);
   255→    try {
   256→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   257→      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   258→
   259→      const dbUpdates: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};
   260→      if (updates.name !== undefined) dbUpdates.name = updates.name;
   261→      if (updates.aspectRatio !== undefined) dbUpdates.aspect_ratio = updates.aspectRatio;
   262→
   263→      const { data: updatedProject, error } = await supabase
   264→        .from('projects')
   265→        .update(dbUpdates)
   266→        .eq('id', projectId)
   267→        .eq('user_id', user.id)
   268→        .select()
   269→        .single();
   270→
   271→      if (error) throw error;
   272→
   273→      const mappedProject = mapDbProjectToProject(updatedProject);
   274→
   275→      setProjects(prevProjects =>
   276→        sortProjectsByCreatedAt(
   277→          prevProjects.map(p => p.id === projectId ? mappedProject : p)
   278→        )
   279→      );
   280→      return true;
   281→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   282→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to update project' });
   283→      return false;
   284→    } finally {
   285→      setIsUpdatingProject(false);
   286→    }
   287→  }, []);
   288→
   289→  const deleteProject = useCallback(async (projectId: string): Promise<boolean> => {
   290→    setIsDeletingProject(true);
   291→    try {
   292→      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
   293→      if (!session) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   294→
   295→      const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('delete-project', {
   296→        body: { projectId },
   297→      });
   298→
   299→      if (error) throw error;
   300→      if (data?.error) throw new Error(data.error);
   301→
   302→      // Filter outside updater so we can call the side-effect callback separately
   303→      // (React state updaters must be pure — no side effects)
   304→      const updated = projects.filter(p => p.id !== projectId);
   305→      setProjects(updated);
   306→      onProjectDeleted(updated);
   307→
   308→      return true;
   309→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   310→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to delete project' });
   311→      return false;
   312→    } finally {
   313→      setIsDeletingProject(false);
   314→    }
   315→  }, [onProjectDeleted, projects]);
   316→
   317→  return {
   318→    projects,
   319→    isLoadingProjects,
   320→    fetchProjects,
   321→    addNewProject,
   322→    isCreatingProject,
   323→    updateProject,
   324→    isUpdatingProject,
   325→    deleteProject,
   326→    isDeletingProject,
   327→  };
   328→}
   329→

    44→async function handleOrchestratorCancellationBilling(

   140→/**
   141→ * Handles cascading task failures/cancellations for orchestrated tasks.
   142→ * When a task fails or is cancelled, this function:
   143→ * 1. Finds the orchestrator task (if the failed task references one)
   144→ * 2. Finds all sibling tasks that reference the same orchestrator
   145→ * 3. Marks them all as Failed/Cancelled appropriately
   146→ */
   147→async function handleCascadingTaskFailure(
   148→  supabaseAdmin: any,
   149→  logger: SystemLogger,
   150→  failedTaskId: string,
   151→  failureStatus: string,
   152→  failedTaskData: any
   153→) {
   154→  try {
   155→    logger.info("Processing cascading failure", { 
   156→      task_id: failedTaskId, 
   157→      status: failureStatus 
   158→    });
   159→    
   160→    // Extract orchestrator reference from the failed task's params
   161→    // Must check all possible paths where orchestrator_task_id might be stored
   162→    let orchestratorTaskId: string | null = null;
   163→    let isOrchestratorTask = false;
   164→    
   165→    if (failedTaskData.params) {
   166→      const params = typeof failedTaskData.params === 'string' 
   167→        ? JSON.parse(failedTaskData.params) 
   168→        : failedTaskData.params;
   169→      
   170→      // Check all paths (shared with calculate-task-cost and complete_task)
   171→      orchestratorTaskId = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
   172→      
   173→      // Check if this task IS the orchestrator (has orchestrator_details but no orchestrator reference)
   174→      if (!orchestratorTaskId && params.orchestrator_details) {
   175→        orchestratorTaskId = failedTaskId;
   176→        isOrchestratorTask = true;
   177→        logger.debug("Task is the orchestrator itself", { task_id: failedTaskId });
   178→      }
   179→    }
   180→    
   181→    if (!orchestratorTaskId) {
   182→      logger.debug("No orchestrator reference found, skipping cascade", { task_id: failedTaskId });
   183→      return;
   184→    }
   185→    
   186→    logger.info("Found orchestrator task", { 
   187→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   188→      is_orchestrator_task: isOrchestratorTask
   189→    });
   190→    
   191→    // Atomically update all related tasks that haven't already reached a terminal state.
   192→    // Using a single UPDATE with filters instead of read-then-update-each to avoid
   193→    // race conditions where a child could complete between the read and the update.
   194→    const cascadePayload = {
   195→      status: failureStatus,
   196→      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   197→      error_message: `Cascaded ${failureStatus.toLowerCase()} from related task ${failedTaskId}`
   198→    };
   199→
   200→    let cascadeResult;
   201→
   202→    if (isOrchestratorTask) {
   203→      // If the failed task IS the orchestrator, cascade to all children
   204→      cascadeResult = await supabaseAdmin
   205→        .from("tasks")
   206→        .update(cascadePayload)
   207→        .or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   208→        .neq("id", failedTaskId)
   209→        .not("status", "in", '("Complete","Failed","Cancelled")')
   210→        .select("id");
   211→    } else {
   212→      // If a child task failed, cascade to orchestrator + all siblings
   213→      cascadeResult = await supabaseAdmin
   214→        .from("tasks")
   215→        .update(cascadePayload)
   216→        .or(`id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId},${buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId)}`)
   217→        .neq("id", failedTaskId)
   218→        .not("status", "in", '("Complete","Failed","Cancelled")')
   219→        .select("id");
   220→    }
   221→
   222→    if (cascadeResult.error) {
   223→      logger.error("Error cascading failure to related tasks", { error: cascadeResult.error.message });
   224→      return;
   225→    }
   226→
   227→    const cascadedCount = cascadeResult.data?.length ?? 0;
   228→
   229→    if (cascadedCount === 0) {
   230→      logger.debug("No related tasks found for cascade (all already terminal or none exist)");
   231→    } else {
   232→      logger.info("Cascade complete", {
   233→        task_id: failedTaskId,
   234→        cascaded_count: cascadedCount,

   236→        status: failureStatus

   240→  } catch (error: any) {

   388→    // This allows billing to start from when actual work begins, not when task was claimed
   389→    if (requestBody.reset_generation_started_at === true) {
   390→      updatePayload.generation_started_at = new Date().toISOString();
   391→    }
   392→    
   393→    if (status === "Complete") {
   394→      updatePayload.generation_processed_at = new Date().toISOString();
   395→    }
   396→
   397→    // Handle output_location for Failed/Complete statuses
   398→    if (output_location !== undefined) {
   399→      updatePayload.output_location = output_location;
   400→    }
   401→
   402→    // Handle retry-related fields
   403→    if (attempts !== undefined) {
   404→      updatePayload.attempts = attempts;
   405→    }
   406→
   407→    if (error_details !== undefined) {
   408→      updatePayload.error_message = error_details;
   409→    }
   410→
   411→    // When requeuing, clear worker assignment
   412→    if (clear_worker === true) {
   413→      updatePayload.worker_id = null;
   414→      updatePayload.generation_started_at = null;
   415→    }
   416→
   417→    let updateResult;
   418→
   419→    if (isServiceRole) {
   420→      // Service role: can update any task
   421→      updateResult = await supabaseAdmin
   422→        .from("tasks")
   423→        .update(updatePayload)
   424→        .eq("id", task_id)
   425→        .select()
   426→        .single();
   427→
   428→    } else {
   429→      // User token: can only update tasks in their projects
   430→      const { data: userProjects } = await supabaseAdmin
   431→        .from("projects")
   432→        .select("id")
   433→        .eq("user_id", callerId);
   434→
   435→      if (!userProjects || userProjects.length === 0) {
   436→        logger.error("User has no projects", { user_id: callerId ?? undefined });
   437→        await logger.flush();
   438→        return new Response("User has no projects", { status: 403 });
   439→      }
   440→
   441→      const projectIds = userProjects.map((p: any) => p.id);
   442→      
   443→      updateResult = await supabaseAdmin
   444→        .from("tasks")
   445→        .update(updatePayload)
   446→        .eq("id", task_id)
   447→        .in("project_id", projectIds)
   448→        .select()
   449→        .single();
   450→    }
   451→
   452→    if (updateResult.error) {
   453→      if (updateResult.error.code === "PGRST116") {
   454→        logger.warn("Task not found or not accessible", { task_id });
   455→        await logger.flush();
   456→        return new Response("Task not found or not accessible", { status: 404 });
   457→      }
   458→      logger.error("Database update error", { 
   459→        task_id,
   460→        error: updateResult.error.message,
   461→        code: updateResult.error.code
   462→      });
   463→      await logger.flush();
   464→      return new Response(`Database error: ${updateResult.error.message}`, { status: 500 });
   465→    }
   466→
   467→    if (!updateResult.data) {
   468→      logger.warn("Task not found or not accessible (no data)", { task_id });
   469→      await logger.flush();
   470→      return new Response("Task not found or not accessible", { status: 404 });
   471→    }
   472→
   473→    logger.info("Task status updated successfully", { 
   474→      task_id, 
   475→      old_status: currentTask?.status,
   476→      new_status: status 
   477→    });
   478→
   479→    // Handle cascading failures/cancellations for orchestrated tasks
   480→    if (status === "Failed" || status === "Cancelled") {
   481→      await handleCascadingTaskFailure(supabaseAdmin, logger, task_id, status, updateResult.data);
   482→      
   483→      // Bill for completed work when orchestrator is cancelled
   484→      if (status === "Cancelled") {
   485→        await handleOrchestratorCancellationBilling(
   486→          supabaseAdmin, 
   487→          supabaseUrl, 
   488→          serviceKey, 
   489→          logger, 
   490→          task_id, 
   491→          updateResult.data
   492→        );
   493→      }
   494→    }
   495→    
   496→    await logger.flush();
   497→    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   498→      success: true,
   499→      task_id: task_id,
   500→      status: status,
   501→      message: `Task status updated to '${status}'`
   502→    }), {
   503→      status: 200,
   504→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   505→    });
   506→
   507→  } catch (error: any) {
   508→    logger.critical("Unexpected error", { task_id, error: error?.message });
   509→    await logger.flush();
   510→    return new Response(`Internal server error: ${error?.message}`, { status: 500 });
   511→  }
   512→});

    33→// Helper for standard JSON responses with CORS headers
    34→function jsonResponse(body: Record<string, unknown>, status = 200) {
    35→  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    36→    status,
    37→    headers: {

    39→      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    40→      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",

    46→// Verify Stripe webhook signature
    47→async function verifyStripeSignature(payload: string, signature: string, secret: string): Promise<boolean> {
    48→  const elements = signature.split(',');
    49→  const timestamp = elements.find(element => element.startsWith('t='))?.split('=')[1];
    50→  const signatures = elements.filter(element => element.startsWith('v1='));
    51→
    52→  if (!timestamp || signatures.length === 0) {
    53→    return false;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  const payloadForSigning = `${timestamp}.${payload}`;
    57→  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    58→    'raw',
    59→    new TextEncoder().encode(secret),
    60→    { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    61→    false,
    62→    ['sign']
    63→  );
    64→
    65→  const signature_bytes = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, new TextEncoder().encode(payloadForSigning));
    66→  const signature_hex = Array.from(new Uint8Array(signature_bytes))
    67→    .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
    68→    .join('');
    69→
    70→  return signatures.some(sig => sig.split('=')[1] === signature_hex);
    71→}

    97→    const body = await req.text();

   104→    const webhookSecret = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET');

   106→      logger.error('STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET not set in environment');
   107→      await logger.flush();
   108→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Webhook secret not configured' }, 500);

   112→    const isValid = await verifyStripeSignature(body, signature, webhookSecret);
   113→    if (!isValid) {

   116→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Invalid signature' }, 401);
   117→    }
