   119→    const event = JSON.parse(body) as StripeEvent;
   120→    logger.info('Received Stripe event', { eventType: event.type });
   121→
   122→    // Handle different event types
   123→    switch (event.type) {
   124→      case 'checkout.session.completed':
   125→        const session = event.data.object;
   126→
   127→        // Extract metadata from the session
   128→        const { userId, amount, autoTopupEnabled, autoTopupAmount, autoTopupThreshold } =
   129→          (session.metadata ?? {}) as CheckoutSessionMetadata;
   130→
   131→        if (!userId || !amount) {
   132→          logger.error('Missing required metadata in checkout session', { metadata: session.metadata as Record<string, unknown> });
   133→          return jsonResponse({ error: 'Missing required metadata' }, 400);
   134→        }
   135→
   136→        // Validate amount matches what was paid
   137→        const dollarAmount = parseFloat(amount);
   138→        const expectedCents = dollarAmount * 100;
   139→
   140→        if (session.amount_total !== expectedCents) {
   141→          logger.error('Amount mismatch', { expectedCents, actualCents: session.amount_total as number });
   142→          return jsonResponse({ error: 'Amount mismatch' }, 400);
   143→        }
   144→
   145→        // Handle auto-top-up setup if enabled
   146→        if (autoTopupEnabled === 'true' && autoTopupAmount && autoTopupThreshold) {
   147→          // Get payment intent to extract customer and payment method
   148→          const paymentIntentId = session.payment_intent as string | undefined;
   149→          if (paymentIntentId) {
   150→            try {
   151→              // This requires importing Stripe in webhook - let's use a simple approach
   152→              // We'll fetch the payment intent details using Stripe API
   153→              const stripeSecretKey = Deno.env.get("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY");
   154→              if (stripeSecretKey) {
   155→                // For now, we'll store the session data and let a background job handle Stripe API calls
   156→                // This avoids complex Stripe SDK imports in the webhook
   157→                const { error: autoTopupError } = await supabaseAdmin
   158→                  .from('users')
   159→                  .update({
   160→                    auto_topup_enabled: true,
   161→                    auto_topup_setup_completed: true, // Mark as setup completed when Stripe setup finishes
   162→                    auto_topup_amount: Math.round(parseFloat(autoTopupAmount) * 100), // Convert to cents
   163→                    auto_topup_threshold: Math.round(parseFloat(autoTopupThreshold) * 100), // Convert to cents
   164→                    stripe_customer_id: session.customer, // Customer ID from session
   165→                  })
   166→                  .eq('id', userId);
   167→
   168→                if (autoTopupError) {
   169→                  logger.error('Error setting up auto-top-up', { error: autoTopupError.message, user_id: userId });
   170→                } else {
   171→                  logger.info('Auto-top-up enabled for user', {
   172→                    user_id: userId,
   173→                    autoTopupAmount: parseFloat(autoTopupAmount),
   174→                    autoTopupThreshold: parseFloat(autoTopupThreshold),
   175→                    customerId: session.customer as string
   176→                  });
   177→                }
   178→              }
   179→            } catch (error: unknown) {
   180→              logger.error('Error processing auto-top-up setup', { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
   181→            }
   182→          }
   183→        }
   184→
   185→        // Fast-path idempotency check: skip processing if already recorded.
   186→        // This is an optimization — the unique partial index on
   187→        // (metadata->>'stripe_session_id') WHERE type = 'stripe' is the
   188→        // actual atomicity guarantee (see migration 20260130220000).
   189→        try {
   190→          const { data: existingEntry, error: checkError } = await supabaseAdmin
   191→            .from('credits_ledger')
   192→            .select('id')
   193→            .eq('type', 'stripe')
   194→            .eq('metadata->>stripe_session_id', session.id)
   195→            .limit(1)
   196→            .maybeSingle();
   197→
   198→          if (checkError) {
   199→            logger.warn('Idempotency check query failed, proceeding with insert', { error: checkError.message });
   200→          } else if (existingEntry) {
   201→            logger.info('Webhook already processed (idempotency check)', { sessionId: session.id as string });
   202→            return jsonResponse({ received: true, duplicate: true });
   203→          }
   204→        } catch (checkErr: unknown) {
   205→          logger.warn('Idempotency check exception, proceeding with insert', { error: String(checkErr) });
   206→        }
   207→
   208→        // Insert budget purchase into ledger.
   209→        // The unique partial index guarantees no double-crediting even if two
   210→        // webhooks race past the fast-path check above.
   211→        const { data: ledgerEntry, error: ledgerError } = await supabaseAdmin
   212→          .from('credits_ledger')
   213→          .insert({
   214→            user_id: userId,
   215→            amount: session.amount_total, // Amount in cents
   216→            type: 'stripe',
   217→            metadata: {
   218→              stripe_session_id: session.id,
   219→              amount_paid: session.amount_total,
   220→              currency: session.currency,
   221→              dollar_amount: dollarAmount,
   222→              auto_topup_enabled: autoTopupEnabled === 'true',
   223→            },
   224→          })
   225→          .select()
   226→          .single();
   227→
   228→        if (ledgerError) {
   229→          // Unique constraint violation = duplicate webhook (race with fast-path check).
   230→          // This is expected and safe — return success since the credit was already applied.
   231→          if (ledgerError.code === '23505') {
   232→            logger.info('Webhook duplicate detected via unique constraint', { sessionId: session.id as string });
   233→            return jsonResponse({ received: true, duplicate: true });
   234→          }
   235→          logger.error('Error creating budget ledger entry', { error: ledgerError.message });
   236→          return jsonResponse({ error: 'Failed to create budget ledger entry' }, 500);
   237→        }
   238→
   239→        logger.info('Successfully processed budget purchase', {
   240→          user_id: userId,
   241→          amountCents: session.amount_total as number,
   242→          dollarAmount,
   243→          sessionId: session.id as string,
   244→          autoTopupEnabled: autoTopupEnabled === 'true',
   245→        });
   246→
   247→        break;
   248→
   249→      case 'payment_intent.succeeded':
   250→        // Handle successful auto-top-up payments
   251→        const paymentIntent = event.data.object;
   252→        const metadata = (paymentIntent.metadata ?? {}) as PaymentIntentMetadata;
   253→
   254→        if (metadata.autoTopup === 'true') {
   255→          const { userId, originalBalance, topupAmount } = metadata;
   256→
   257→          if (userId && topupAmount) {
   258→            // Fast-path idempotency check: skip processing if already recorded.
   259→            // The unique partial index on (metadata->>'stripe_payment_intent_id')
   260→            // WHERE type = 'auto_topup' is the actual atomicity guarantee
   261→            // (see migration 20260130220000).
   262→            let skipInsert = false;
   263→            try {
   264→              const { data: existingAutoTopup, error: checkError } = await supabaseAdmin
   265→                .from('credits_ledger')
   266→                .select('id')
   267→                .eq('type', 'auto_topup')
   268→                .eq('metadata->>stripe_payment_intent_id', paymentIntent.id)
   269→                .limit(1)
   270→                .maybeSingle();
   271→
   272→              if (checkError) {
   273→                logger.warn('Auto-topup idempotency check failed, proceeding with insert', { error: checkError.message });
   274→              } else if (existingAutoTopup) {
   275→                logger.info('Auto-topup webhook already processed (idempotency check)', { paymentIntentId: paymentIntent.id as string });
   276→                skipInsert = true;
   277→              }
   278→            } catch (checkErr: unknown) {
   279→              logger.warn('Auto-topup idempotency check exception, proceeding with insert', { error: String(checkErr) });
   280→            }
   281→
   282→            if (skipInsert) {
   283→              break;
   284→            }
   285→
   286→            // Insert auto-top-up credit into ledger.
   287→            // The unique partial index guarantees no double-crediting even if two
   288→            // webhooks race past the fast-path check above.
   289→            const { error: autoTopupLedgerError } = await supabaseAdmin
   290→              .from('credits_ledger')
   291→              .insert({
   292→                user_id: userId,
   293→                amount: parseInt(topupAmount), // Already in cents
   294→                type: 'auto_topup',
   295→                metadata: {
   296→                  stripe_payment_intent_id: paymentIntent.id,
   297→                  amount_paid: paymentIntent.amount_received,
   298→                  currency: paymentIntent.currency,
   299→                  dollar_amount: parseInt(topupAmount) / 100,
   300→                  original_balance: parseInt(originalBalance || '0'),
   301→                  auto_topup_trigger: true,
   302→                },
   303→              });
   304→
   305→            if (autoTopupLedgerError) {
   306→              // Unique constraint violation = duplicate webhook (race with fast-path check).
   307→              // This is expected and safe — return success since the credit was already applied.
   308→              if (autoTopupLedgerError.code === '23505') {
   309→                logger.info('Auto-topup duplicate detected via unique constraint', { paymentIntentId: paymentIntent.id as string });
   310→                break;
   311→              }
   312→              logger.error('Error creating auto-top-up ledger entry', { error: autoTopupLedgerError.message });
   313→            } else {
   314→              logger.info('Auto-top-up payment processed', {
   315→                user_id: userId,
   316→                paymentIntentId: paymentIntent.id as string,
   317→                topupAmount: parseInt(topupAmount),
   318→                dollarAmount: parseInt(topupAmount) / 100,
   319→              });
   320→            }
   321→          }
   322→        }
   323→        break;
   324→
   325→      case 'payment_intent.payment_failed':
   326→        // Handle failed auto-top-up payments
   327→        const failedPaymentIntent = event.data.object;
   328→        const failedMetadata = (failedPaymentIntent.metadata ?? {}) as PaymentIntentMetadata;
   329→
   330→        if (failedMetadata.autoTopup === 'true') {
   331→          const { userId } = failedMetadata;
   332→
   333→          if (userId) {
   334→            const lastPaymentError = failedPaymentIntent.last_payment_error as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   335→            logger.error('Auto-top-up payment failed', {
   336→              user_id: userId,
   337→              paymentIntentId: failedPaymentIntent.id as string,
   338→              errorCode: lastPaymentError?.code as string,
   339→              errorMessage: lastPaymentError?.message as string,
   340→            });
   341→
   342→            // On certain failure types, disable auto-top-up to prevent repeated failures
   343→            const errorCode = lastPaymentError?.code as string | undefined;
   344→            if (errorCode === 'card_declined' || errorCode === 'expired_card') {
   345→              const { error: disableError } = await supabaseAdmin
   346→                .from('users')
   347→                .update({ auto_topup_enabled: false })
   348→                .eq('id', userId);
   349→
   350→              if (disableError) {
   351→                logger.error('Error disabling auto-top-up after payment failure', { error: disableError.message, user_id: userId });
   352→              } else {
   353→                logger.info('Auto-top-up disabled for user due to payment failure', { user_id: userId, errorCode });
   354→              }
   355→            }
   356→          }
   357→        }
   358→        break;
   359→
   360→      case 'invoice.payment_succeeded':
   361→        // Handle recurring subscription payments if needed in the future
   362→        logger.info('Invoice payment succeeded (not implemented yet)');
   363→        break;
   364→
   365→      case 'invoice.payment_failed':
   366→        // Handle failed payments if needed
   367→        logger.info('Invoice payment failed (not implemented yet)');
   368→        break;
   369→
   370→      default:
   371→        logger.info('Unhandled event type', { eventType: event.type });
   372→        break;
   373→    }
   374→
   375→    await logger.flush();
   376→    return jsonResponse({ received: true });
   377→
   378→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   379→    logger.error('Error processing Stripe webhook', { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
   380→    await logger.flush();
   381→    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Internal server error' }, 500);
   382→  }
   383→});

     4→import { SystemLogger } from "../_shared/systemLogger.ts";
     5→
     6→const corsHeaders = {
     7→  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
     8→  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type',
     9→};
    10→
    11→function jsonResponse(body: any, status = 200) {
    12→  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    13→    status,
    14→    headers: {
    15→      ...corsHeaders,
    16→      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    17→    },
    18→  });
    19→}
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Edge function: process-auto-topup
    23→ * 
    24→ * Processes automatic credit top-up using saved payment method
    25→ * 
    26→ * POST /functions/v1/process-auto-topup
    27→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <service_role_key>
    28→ * Body: { userId: string }
    29→ * 
    30→ * Returns:
    31→ * - 200 OK with payment details
    32→ * - 400 Bad Request if invalid parameters or user not eligible
    33→ * - 500 Internal Server Error
    34→ */
    35→serve(async (req) => {
    36→  // Handle CORS preflight requests
    37→  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    38→    return jsonResponse({ ok: true });
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    42→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Method not allowed" }, 405);
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  // ─── 1. Parse body ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    46→  let body: any;
    47→  try {
    48→    body = await req.json();
    49→  } catch {
    50→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Invalid JSON body" }, 400);
    51→  }
    52→  
    53→  const { userId } = body;
    54→
    55→  if (!userId || typeof userId !== 'string') {
    56→    return jsonResponse({ error: "userId is required and must be a string" }, 400);
    57→  }
    58→
    59→  // ─── 2. Verify service role authentication ──────────────────────
    60→  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    61→  const serviceRoleKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    62→  
    63→  if (!authHeader?.startsWith("Bearer ") || authHeader.slice(7) !== serviceRoleKey) {
    64→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Unauthorized - service role required" }, 401);
    65→  }
    66→
    67→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
    68→  if (!supabaseUrl || !serviceRoleKey) {
    69→    console.error("Missing required environment variables");
    70→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Server configuration error" }, 500);
    71→  }
    72→
    73→  // ─── 3. Create Supabase admin client ────────────────────────────
    74→  const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceRoleKey, {
    75→    auth: {
    76→      autoRefreshToken: false,
    77→      persistSession: false
    78→    }
    79→  });
    80→
    81→  const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'process-auto-topup');
    82→
    83→  try {
    84→    // ─── 4. Get user auto-top-up settings ───────────────────────────
    85→    const { data: user, error: userError } = await supabaseAdmin
    86→      .from('users')
    87→      .select(`
    88→        id,
    89→        credits,
    90→        auto_topup_enabled,
    91→        auto_topup_amount,
    92→        auto_topup_threshold,
    93→        auto_topup_last_triggered,
    94→        stripe_customer_id,
    95→        stripe_payment_method_id,
    96→        email
    97→      `)
    98→      .eq('id', userId)
    99→      .single();
   100→
   101→    if (userError || !user) {
   102→      logger.error('User not found', { user_id: userId, error: userError?.message });
   103→      await logger.flush();
   104→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'User not found' }, 400);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    // ─── 5. Validate eligibility ────────────────────────────────────
   108→    if (!user.auto_topup_enabled) {
   109→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Auto-top-up not enabled for user' }, 400);
   110→    }
   111→
   112→    if (!user.stripe_customer_id || !user.stripe_payment_method_id) {
   113→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Payment method not configured' }, 400);
   114→    }
   115→
   116→    if (!user.auto_topup_amount || !user.auto_topup_threshold) {
   117→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Auto-top-up amounts not configured' }, 400);
   118→    }
   119→
   120→    // Check if balance is still above threshold (may have changed since trigger)
   121→    if (user.credits > user.auto_topup_threshold) {
   122→      return jsonResponse({ 
   123→        message: 'Balance above threshold, auto-top-up not needed',
   124→        currentBalance: user.credits,
   125→        threshold: user.auto_topup_threshold
   126→      });
   127→    }
   128→
   129→    // ─── 5b. Atomic rate-limit claim ──────────────────────────────────
   130→    // Prevents two concurrent triggers from both processing a payment.
   131→    // UPDATE only succeeds if auto_topup_last_triggered is NULL or older than 1 hour.
   132→    // Uses .or() so exactly one concurrent caller wins the row.
   133→    const oneHourAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
   134→    const { data: claimRow, error: claimError } = await supabaseAdmin
   135→      .from('users')
   136→      .update({ auto_topup_last_triggered: new Date().toISOString() })
   137→      .eq('id', userId)
   138→      .or(`auto_topup_last_triggered.is.null,auto_topup_last_triggered.lt.${oneHourAgo}`)
   139→      .select('id')
   140→      .single();
   141→
   142→    if (claimError || !claimRow) {
   143→      logger.info('Auto-top-up skipped: already claimed by concurrent process or rate limited', {
   144→        user_id: userId,
   145→        lastTriggered: user.auto_topup_last_triggered,
   146→        claimError: claimError?.message,
   147→      });
   148→      await logger.flush();
   149→      return jsonResponse({
   150→        error: 'Auto-top-up rate limited - too soon since last trigger or already being processed',
   151→        lastTriggered: user.auto_topup_last_triggered
   152→      }, 400);
   153→    }
   154→
   155→    // ─── 6. Initialize Stripe and create Payment Intent ─────────────
   156→    const stripeSecretKey = Deno.env.get("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY");
   157→    if (!stripeSecretKey) {
   158→      logger.error("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY not set in environment");
   159→      await logger.flush();
   160→      return jsonResponse({ error: "Stripe not configured" }, 500);
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    const stripe = new Stripe(stripeSecretKey, {
   164→      apiVersion: "2024-06-20",
   165→    });
   166→
   167→    // Create off-session payment intent
   168→    const paymentIntent = await stripe.paymentIntents.create({
   169→      amount: user.auto_topup_amount, // Already in cents
   170→      currency: "usd",
   171→      customer: user.stripe_customer_id,
   172→      payment_method: user.stripe_payment_method_id,
   173→      confirmation_method: "automatic",
   174→      confirm: true,
   175→      off_session: true, // This indicates it's an automatic payment
   176→      metadata: {
   177→        userId: user.id,
   178→        autoTopup: "true",
   179→        originalBalance: user.credits.toString(),
   180→        topupAmount: user.auto_topup_amount.toString(),
   181→      },
   182→      description: `Auto-top-up: $${(user.auto_topup_amount / 100).toFixed(2)} credits for ${user.email}`,
   183→    });
   184→
   185→    // ─── 7. Handle payment result ───────────────────────────────────
   186→    if (paymentIntent.status === 'succeeded') {
   187→      // Insert successful auto-top-up into ledger
   188→      const { error: ledgerError } = await supabaseAdmin
   189→        .from('credits_ledger')
   190→        .insert({
   191→          user_id: userId,
   192→          amount: user.auto_topup_amount,
   193→          type: 'auto_topup',
   194→          metadata: {
   195→            stripe_payment_intent_id: paymentIntent.id,
   196→            amount_paid: paymentIntent.amount_received,
   197→            currency: paymentIntent.currency,
   198→            dollar_amount: user.auto_topup_amount / 100,
   199→            original_balance: user.credits,
   200→            auto_topup_trigger: true,
   201→          },
   202→        });
   203→
   204→      if (ledgerError) {
   205→        logger.error('Error creating auto-top-up ledger entry', { error: ledgerError.message, user_id: userId });
   206→        await logger.flush();
   207→        // Payment succeeded but ledger failed - this is critical
   208→        return jsonResponse({ error: 'Payment succeeded but failed to update credits' }, 500);
   209→      }
   210→
   211→      logger.info('Auto-top-up succeeded', {
   212→        user_id: userId,
   213→        paymentIntentId: paymentIntent.id,
   214→        amount: user.auto_topup_amount,
   215→        originalBalance: user.credits,
   216→      });
   217→
   218→      await logger.flush();
   219→      return jsonResponse({
   220→        success: true,
   221→        paymentIntentId: paymentIntent.id,
   222→        amount: user.auto_topup_amount,
   223→        dollarAmount: user.auto_topup_amount / 100,
   224→        originalBalance: user.credits,
   225→        message: `Auto-topped up $${(user.auto_topup_amount / 100).toFixed(2)}`
   226→      });
   227→
   228→    } else {
   229→      // Payment failed
   230→      logger.error('Auto-top-up payment failed', {
   231→        user_id: userId,
   232→        paymentIntentId: paymentIntent.id,
   233→        status: paymentIntent.status,
   234→        lastPaymentError: paymentIntent.last_payment_error,
   235→      });
   236→
   237→      // Consider disabling auto-top-up on certain failure types
   238→      if (paymentIntent.last_payment_error?.code === 'card_declined' ||
   239→          paymentIntent.last_payment_error?.code === 'expired_card') {
   240→        
   241→        // Disable auto-top-up to prevent repeated failures
   242→        await supabaseAdmin
   243→          .from('users')
   244→          .update({ auto_topup_enabled: false })
   245→          .eq('id', userId);
   246→
   247→        logger.info(`Auto-top-up disabled for user due to payment failure`, { user_id: userId });
   248→      }
   249→
   250→      await logger.flush();
   251→      return jsonResponse({
   252→        error: 'Auto-top-up payment failed',
   253→        paymentIntentId: paymentIntent.id,
   254→        failureCode: paymentIntent.last_payment_error?.code,
   255→        failureMessage: paymentIntent.last_payment_error?.message,
   256→      }, 400);
   257→    }
   258→
   259→  } catch (error) {
   260→    logger.error('Error in process-auto-topup', { error: error.message });
   261→    
   262→    // Handle specific Stripe errors
   263→    if (error.type === 'StripeCardError') {
   264→      return jsonResponse({
   265→        error: 'Card error during auto-top-up',
   266→        code: error.code,
   267→        message: error.message,
   268→      }, 400);
   269→    }
   270→
   271→    await logger.flush();
   272→    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Internal server error' }, 500);
   273→  }
   274→});

1→/**
     2→ * Shared billing utilities for edge functions
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes:
     5→ *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)
     6→ *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls
     7→ *  - Cost calculation HTTP trigger
     8→ *
     9→ * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task
    10→ */
    11→
    12→// ===== Constants =====
    13→
    14→/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */
    15→export const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    16→
    17→// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====
    18→
    19→/**
    20→ * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.
    21→ *
    22→ * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths
    23→ * depending on the task type and how they were created:
    24→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)
    25→ *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)
    26→ *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)
    27→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)
    28→ *
    29→ * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.
    30→ */
    31→export function extractOrchestratorRef(params: any): string | null {
    32→  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;
    33→
    34→  return (
    35→    params.orchestrator_task_id_ref ||
    36→    params.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||
    37→    params.originalParams?.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||
    38→    params.orchestrator_task_id ||
    39→    null
    40→  );
    41→}
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.
    45→ *
    46→ * A task is a sub-task when:
    47→ *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)
    48→ *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)
    49→ *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID
    50→ *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)
    51→ *
    52→ * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)
    53→ * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references
    54→ * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise
    55→ */
    56→export function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: any, taskId: string): string | null {
    57→  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
    58→  if (!ref) return null;
    59→  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;
    60→  if (ref === taskId) return null;
    61→  return ref;
    62→}
    63→
    64→// ===== Sub-task query filter =====
    65→
    66→/**
    67→ * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks
    68→ * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.
    69→ *
    70→ * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.
    71→ *
    72→ * Usage:
    73→ *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))
    74→ */
    75→export function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
    76→  return [
    77→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id_ref.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    78→    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    79→    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    80→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    81→  ].join(',');
    82→}
    83→
    84→// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====
    85→
    86→/**
    87→ * Trigger the calculate-task-cost edge function for a given task.
    88→ *
    89→ * This is a fire-and-forget HTTP call (errors are logged, not thrown).
    90→ *
    91→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
    92→ * @param serviceKey  - The service role key for authentication
    93→ * @param taskId      - The task ID to calculate cost for
    94→ * @param logTag      - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')
    95→ */
    96→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
    97→  supabaseUrl: string,
    98→  serviceKey: string,
    99→  taskId: string,
   100→  logTag: string = 'CostCalc'
   101→): Promise<void> {
   102→  try {
   103→    console.log(`[${logTag}] Triggering cost calculation for ${taskId}...`);
   104→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
   105→      method: "POST",
   106→      headers: {
   107→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
   108→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
   109→      },
   110→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
   111→    });
   112→
   113→    if (costResp.ok) {
   114→      const costData = await costResp.json();
   115→      if (costData.skipped) {
   116→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation skipped: ${costData.reason}`);
   117→      } else if (typeof costData.cost === 'number') {
   118→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation successful: $${costData.cost.toFixed(3)}`);
   119→      }
   120→    } else {
   121→      const errTxt = await costResp.text();
   122→      console.error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation failed: ${errTxt}`);
   123→    }
   124→  } catch (costErr) {
   125→    console.error(`[${logTag}] Error triggering cost calculation:`, costErr);
   126→  }
   127→}
   128→

1→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { Shot } from '@/types/shots';
     3→
     4→type ShotSortMode = 'ordered' | 'newest' | 'oldest';
     5→
     6→interface UseNavigationStateOptions {
     7→  /** Array of shots */
     8→  shots: Shot[] | undefined;
     9→  /** Current sort mode */
    10→  shotSortMode: ShotSortMode;
    11→  /** Currently selected shot */
    12→  selectedShot: Shot | null;
    13→}
    14→
    15→interface UseNavigationStateResult {
    16→  /** Shots sorted according to shotSortMode */
    17→  sortedShots: Shot[] | undefined;
    18→  /** Index of selected shot in sortedShots (-1 if not found) */
    19→  currentShotIndex: number;
    20→  /** Whether there's a previous shot to navigate to */
    21→  hasPrevious: boolean;
    22→  /** Whether there's a next shot to navigate to */
    23→  hasNext: boolean;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/**
    27→ * Computes sorted shots array and navigation state (prev/next availability).
    28→ *
    29→ * Sorting modes:
    30→ * - 'ordered': By timeline_frame field (default shot order)
    31→ * - 'newest': By created_at descending
    32→ * - 'oldest': By created_at ascending
    33→ */
    34→export function useNavigationState({
    35→  shots,
    36→  shotSortMode,
    37→  selectedShot,
    38→}: UseNavigationStateOptions): UseNavigationStateResult {
    39→  // Sort shots based on shotSortMode
    40→  const sortedShots = useMemo(() => {
    41→    if (!shots) return shots;
    42→
    43→    if (shotSortMode === 'newest') {
    44→      return [...shots].sort((a, b) => {
    45→        const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
    46→        const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
    47→        return dateB - dateA; // Newest first
    48→      });
    49→    } else if (shotSortMode === 'oldest') {
    50→      return [...shots].sort((a, b) => {
    51→        const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
    52→        const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
    53→        return dateA - dateB; // Oldest first
    54→      });
    55→    } else {
    56→      // 'ordered' mode - sort by timeline_frame
    57→      return [...shots].sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
    58→    }
    59→  }, [shots, shotSortMode]);
    60→
    61→  // Calculate navigation state
    62→  const navigationState = useMemo(() => {
    63→    const currentShotIndex = sortedShots?.findIndex(shot => shot.id === selectedShot?.id) ?? -1;
    64→    return {
    65→      currentShotIndex,
    66→      hasPrevious: currentShotIndex > 0,
    67→      hasNext: currentShotIndex >= 0 && currentShotIndex < (sortedShots?.length ?? 0) - 1,
    68→    };
    69→  }, [sortedShots, selectedShot?.id]);
    70→
    71→  return {
    72→    sortedShots,
    73→    ...navigationState,
    74→  };
    75→}
    76→

    76→  const shots = React.useMemo(() => {
    77→    const baseList = optimisticShots || propShots;
    78→    if (!baseList) return baseList;
    79→    
    80→    // Skip sorting during optimistic updates to allow smooth drag feedback
    81→    if (reorderShotsMutation.isPending) {
    82→      return baseList;
    83→    }
    84→    
    85→    // Apply sorting based on sortMode
    86→    let sorted: Shot[];
    87→    if (sortMode === 'newest') {
    88→      // Sort by created_at descending (newest first)
    89→      sorted = [...baseList].sort((a, b) => {
    90→        const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
    91→        const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
    92→        return dateB - dateA;
    93→      });
    94→    } else if (sortMode === 'oldest') {
    95→      // Sort by created_at ascending (oldest first)
    96→      sorted = [...baseList].sort((a, b) => {
    97→        const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
    98→        const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
    99→        return dateA - dateB;
   100→      });
   101→    } else {
   102→      // Default 'ordered' mode - sort by timeline_frame
   103→      sorted = [...baseList].sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
   104→    }
   105→    
   106→    return sorted;
   107→  }, [propShots, optimisticShots, reorderShotsMutation.isPending, sortMode]);
   108→
   109→  // Clear optimistic overlay when mutation settles
   110→  React.useEffect(() => {
   111→    if (!reorderShotsMutation.isPending && optimisticShots) {
   112→      setOptimisticShots(null);
   113→    }
   114→  }, [reorderShotsMutation.isPending, optimisticShots]);
   115→  
   116→  // Check if focus is on an input element to conditionally disable KeyboardSensor
   117→  const [isInputFocused, setIsInputFocused] = React.useState(false);
   118→  
   119→  React.useEffect(() => {
   120→    const handleFocusIn = (e: FocusEvent) => {
   121→      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   122→      const isFormElement = target.tagName === 'INPUT' || 
   123→                           target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || 
   124→                           target.contentEditable === 'true';
   125→      setIsInputFocused(isFormElement);
   126→    };
   127→    
   128→    const handleFocusOut = (e: FocusEvent) => {
   129→      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   130→      const isFormElement = target.tagName === 'INPUT' || 
   131→                           target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || 
   132→                           target.contentEditable === 'true';
   133→      if (isFormElement) {
   134→        setIsInputFocused(false);
   135→      }
   136→    };
   137→    
   138→    document.addEventListener('focusin', handleFocusIn);
   139→    document.addEventListener('focusout', handleFocusOut);
   140→    
   141→    return () => {
   142→      document.removeEventListener('focusin', handleFocusIn);
   143→      document.removeEventListener('focusout', handleFocusOut);
   144→    };
   145→  }, []);
   146→
   147→  // Set up sensors for drag and drop
   148→  // Always create the keyboard sensor but conditionally disable it
   149→  const keyboardSensor = useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {
   150→    coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates,
   151→  });
   152→  
   153→  const sensors = useSensors(
   154→    useSensor(MouseSensor, {
   155→      activationConstraint: {
   156→        distance: 8, // 8px of movement required before drag starts
   157→      },
   158→    }),
   159→    useSensor(TouchSensor, {
   160→      activationConstraint: {
   161→        delay: 250,
   162→        tolerance: 5,
   163→      },
   164→    }),
   165→    keyboardSensor
   166→  );
   167→
   168→  const handleDragStart = (_event: DragStartEvent) => {
   169→    // Prevent drag if an input is focused
   170→    if (isInputFocused) {
   171→      return false;
   172→    }
   173→  };
   174→
   175→  const handleDragEnd = (event: DragEndEvent) => {
   176→    const { active, over } = event;
   177→
   178→    if (!over || !shots || !currentProjectId) {
   179→      return;
   180→    }
   181→
   182→    if (active.id !== over.id) {
   183→      const oldIndex = shots.findIndex((shot) => shot.id === active.id);
   184→      const newIndex = shots.findIndex((shot) => shot.id === over.id);
   185→
   186→      if (oldIndex === -1 || newIndex === -1) {
   187→        return;
   188→      }
   189→
   190→      // Create new order array
   191→      const reorderedShots = arrayMove(shots, oldIndex, newIndex);
   192→
   193→      // Update positions on the reordered shots
   194→      const shotsWithNewPositions = reorderedShots.map((shot, index) => ({
   195→        ...shot,
   196→        position: index + 1,
   197→      }));
   198→
   199→      // Apply local optimistic overlay for immediate visual feedback
   200→      setOptimisticShots(shotsWithNewPositions);
   201→
   202→      // Optimistically update the unlimited shots cache (used by ShotsContext -> useListShots(projectId))
   203→      queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.shots.list(currentProjectId, 0), shotsWithNewPositions);
   204→
   205→      // Generate position updates for database
   206→      const shotOrders = reorderedShots.map((shot, index) => ({
   207→        shotId: shot.id,
   208→        position: index + 1,
   209→      }));
   210→
   211→      // Update positions in database
   212→      reorderShotsMutation.mutate(
   213→        { projectId: currentProjectId, shotOrders },
   214→        {
   215→          onError: (error) => {
   216→            // Revert optimistic updates on both caches on error
   217→            queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.shots.list(currentProjectId), shots);
   218→            queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.shots.list(currentProjectId, 5), shots);
   219→            toast.error(`Failed to reorder shots: ${error.message}`);
   220→          },
   221→        }
   222→      );
   223→    }
   224→  };
   225→
   226→  // Memoize sortable items
   227→  const sortableItems = React.useMemo(() => {
   228→    if (!shots) return [];
   229→    const items = shots.map((shot) => shot.id);
   230→    return items;
   231→  }, [shots]);
   232→
   233→  // Drop state for "New Shot" drop zone
   234→  const [isNewShotDropTarget, setIsNewShotDropTarget] = useState(false);
   235→  const [newShotDropType, setNewShotDropType] = useState<DragType>('none');
   236→  // Processing state for showing loading during upload (legacy - kept for generation drops)
   237→  const [isNewShotProcessing] = useState(false);
   238→  
   239→  // Optimistic skeleton shot state (computed during render like SortableShotItem)
   240→  const pendingNewShotCountRef = useRef(0); // Number of images expected in new shot
   241→  const baselineShotIdsRef = useRef<Set<string> | null>(null); // Shot IDs at drop time
   242→  const safetyTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   243→  // Track newly created shot to transfer pending count to it
   244→  const [newlyCreatedShotId, setNewlyCreatedShotId] = useState<string | null>(null);
   245→  const [newlyCreatedShotExpectedImages, setNewlyCreatedShotExpectedImages] = useState(0);
   246→  const [newlyCreatedShotBaselineNonVideoCount, setNewlyCreatedShotBaselineNonVideoCount] = useState(0);
   247→  
   248→  // Get current shot IDs
   249→  const currentShotIds = shots?.map(s => s.id) || [];
   250→  const currentShotIdsKey = React.useMemo(() => currentShotIds.join('|'), [currentShotIds]);
   251→  
   252→  // If a new shot appears, transfer expected image count to that shot card.
   253→  // (Must be in an effect—never set state during render.)
   254→  // Note: pendingNewShotCountRef can be 0 for empty shots, so only check baselineShotIdsRef
   255→  React.useEffect(() => {
   256→    if (!baselineShotIdsRef.current) return;
   257→    const baseline = baselineShotIdsRef.current;
   258→    const newShotId = currentShotIds.find(id => !baseline.has(id));
   259→    if (!newShotId) return;
   260→
   261→    const expectedImages = pendingNewShotCountRef.current;
   262→    const newShot = shots?.find(s => s.id === newShotId);
   263→    const existingNonVideoCount = (newShot?.images || []).filter(img => !isVideoGeneration(img)).length;
   264→    // Pass *remaining* expected images (avoids forever-skeleton for generation drops where the image already exists)
   265→    const remainingExpectedImages = Math.max(0, expectedImages - existingNonVideoCount);
   266→
   267→    setNewlyCreatedShotId(newShotId);
   268→    setNewlyCreatedShotExpectedImages(remainingExpectedImages);
   269→    setNewlyCreatedShotBaselineNonVideoCount(existingNonVideoCount);
   270→
   271→    // Clear skeleton-shot refs
   272→    pendingNewShotCountRef.current = 0;
   273→    baselineShotIdsRef.current = null;
   274→    if (safetyTimeoutRef.current) {
   275→      clearTimeout(safetyTimeoutRef.current);
   276→      safetyTimeoutRef.current = null;
   277→    }
   278→  }, [currentShotIdsKey]);
   279→
   280→  // Compute pending skeleton shot during render (no flicker)
   281→  // Only show skeleton if the new shot hasn't appeared in the data yet
   282→  // Note: pendingNewShotCountRef can be 0 for empty shots, so check baselineShotIdsRef instead
   283→  let pendingSkeletonShot: { imageCount: number } | null = null;
   284→  if (baselineShotIdsRef.current) {
   285→    const baseline = baselineShotIdsRef.current;
   286→    const newShotAlreadyInData = currentShotIds.some(id => !baseline.has(id));
   287→    if (!newShotAlreadyInData) {
   288→      // Still waiting - show skeleton
   289→      pendingSkeletonShot = { imageCount: pendingNewShotCountRef.current };
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  // Handle drag enter for new shot drop zone
   294→  const handleNewShotDragEnter = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
   295→    const dragType = getDragType(e);
   296→    if (dragType !== 'none' && (onGenerationDropForNewShot || onFilesDropForNewShot)) {
   297→      e.preventDefault();
   298→      e.stopPropagation();
   299→      setIsNewShotDropTarget(true);
   300→      setNewShotDropType(dragType);
   301→    }
   302→  }, [onGenerationDropForNewShot, onFilesDropForNewShot]);
   303→
   304→  // Handle drag over for new shot drop zone
   305→  const handleNewShotDragOver = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
   306→    const dragType = getDragType(e);
   307→    if (dragType !== 'none' && (onGenerationDropForNewShot || onFilesDropForNewShot)) {
   308→      e.preventDefault();
   309→      e.stopPropagation();
   310→      e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'copy';
   311→      setIsNewShotDropTarget(true);
   312→      setNewShotDropType(dragType);
   313→    }
   314→  }, [onGenerationDropForNewShot, onFilesDropForNewShot]);
   315→
   316→  // Handle drag leave for new shot drop zone
   317→  const handleNewShotDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
   318→    if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node)) {
   319→      setIsNewShotDropTarget(false);
   320→      setNewShotDropType('none');
   321→    }
   322→  }, []);
   323→
   324→  // Helper to setup optimistic skeleton shot
   325→  const setupPendingNewShot = useCallback((imageCount: number) => {
   326→    baselineShotIdsRef.current = new Set(currentShotIds);
   327→    pendingNewShotCountRef.current = imageCount;
   328→    
   329→    // Safety timeout - clear after 15s
   330→    if (safetyTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(safetyTimeoutRef.current);
   331→    safetyTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   332→      pendingNewShotCountRef.current = 0;
   333→      baselineShotIdsRef.current = null;
   334→      safetyTimeoutRef.current = null;
   335→    }, 15000);
   336→  }, [currentShotIds]);
   337→  
   338→  const clearPendingNewShot = useCallback(() => {
   339→    pendingNewShotCountRef.current = 0;
   340→    baselineShotIdsRef.current = null;
   341→    if (safetyTimeoutRef.current) {
   342→      clearTimeout(safetyTimeoutRef.current);
   343→      safetyTimeoutRef.current = null;
   344→    }
   345→  }, []);
   346→
   347→  // Expose skeleton setup/clear to parent for modal-based shot creation
   348→  React.useEffect(() => {
   349→    if (onSkeletonSetupReady) {
   350→      onSkeletonSetupReady(setupPendingNewShot, clearPendingNewShot);
   351→    }
   352→  }, [onSkeletonSetupReady, setupPendingNewShot, clearPendingNewShot]);
   353→
   354→  // Listen for shot-pending-create events (from ShotSelectorWithAdd quick create)
   355→  React.useEffect(() => {
   356→    const handlePendingCreate = (event: CustomEvent<{ imageCount: number }>) => {
   357→      const { imageCount } = event.detail;
   358→      setupPendingNewShot(imageCount);
   359→    };
   360→
   361→    const handlePendingCreateClear = () => {
   362→      clearPendingNewShot();
   363→    };
   364→
   365→    window.addEventListener('shot-pending-create', handlePendingCreate as EventListener);
   366→    window.addEventListener('shot-pending-create-clear', handlePendingCreateClear);
   367→    return () => {
   368→      window.removeEventListener('shot-pending-create', handlePendingCreate as EventListener);
   369→      window.removeEventListener('shot-pending-create-clear', handlePendingCreateClear);
   370→    };
   371→  }, [setupPendingNewShot, clearPendingNewShot]);
   372→
   373→  // Handle drop for new shot
   374→  const handleNewShotDrop = useCallback(async (e: React.DragEvent) => {
   375→    e.preventDefault();
   376→    e.stopPropagation();
   377→    setIsNewShotDropTarget(false);
   378→    setNewShotDropType('none');
   379→
   380→    // Try generation drop first
   381→    const generationData = getGenerationDropData(e);
   382→    if (generationData && onGenerationDropForNewShot) {
   383→
   384→      // Show skeleton shot with 1 image
   385→      setupPendingNewShot(1);
   386→      
   387→      try {
   388→        await onGenerationDropForNewShot(generationData);
   389→      } catch (error) {
   390→        handleError(error, { context: 'ShotDrop', toastTitle: 'Failed to create shot' });
   391→        clearPendingNewShot();
   392→      }
   393→      return;
   394→    }
   395→
   396→    // Try file drop
   397→    if (isFileDrag(e) && onFilesDropForNewShot) {
   398→      const files = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files);
   399→      const validImageTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/jpg'];
   400→      const validFiles = files.filter(file => validImageTypes.includes(file.type));
   401→      
   402→      if (validFiles.length === 0) {
   403→        toast.error('No valid image files. Only JPEG, PNG, and WebP are supported.');
   404→        return;
   405→      }
   406→
   407→      // Show skeleton shot with N images
   408→      setupPendingNewShot(validFiles.length);
   409→      
   410→      try {
   411→        await onFilesDropForNewShot(validFiles);
   412→      } catch (error) {
   413→        handleError(error, { context: 'ShotDrop', toastTitle: 'Failed to create shot' });
   414→        clearPendingNewShot();
   415→      }
   416→    }
   417→  }, [onGenerationDropForNewShot, onFilesDropForNewShot, setupPendingNewShot, clearPendingNewShot]);
   418→
   419→  // Show loading skeleton while data is being fetched
   420→  if (shotsLoading || shots === undefined) {
   421→    return (
   422→      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 md:gap-x-6 md:gap-y-5 pb-6 md:pb-8 px-4 pt-4 pb-2 items-start">
   423→        {/* First item: "Create new shot" drop zone skeleton */}
   424→        <div className="p-4 border-2 border-dashed rounded-lg self-start flex flex-col relative animate-pulse">
   425→          {/* Invisible structure to match shot card height */}
   426→          <div className="h-8 mb-3" aria-hidden="true" />
   427→          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2" aria-hidden="true">
   428→            <div className="aspect-square" />
   429→            <div className="aspect-square" />
   430→            <div className="aspect-square" />
   431→          </div>
   432→          {/* Centered content overlay */}
   433→          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
   434→            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
   435→              <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full bg-muted" />
   436→              <div className="h-4 w-24 rounded bg-muted" />
   437→            </div>
   438→          </div>
   439→        </div>
   440→        
   441→        {/* Remaining shot card skeletons */}
   442→        {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, idx) => (
   443→          /* Shot card skeleton - matches VideoShotDisplay structure */
   444→          <div key={idx} className="p-4 border rounded-lg bg-card/50 self-start animate-pulse">
   445→            {/* Header: shot name + action buttons (Video, Pencil, Copy, Trash) */}
   446→            <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-3">
   447→              <div className="h-7 w-32 bg-muted rounded" />
   448→              <div className="flex items-center gap-x-1">
   449→                <div className="h-8 w-8 bg-muted rounded" />
   450→                <div className="h-8 w-8 bg-muted rounded" />
   451→                <div className="h-8 w-8 bg-muted rounded" />
   452→                <div className="h-8 w-8 bg-muted rounded" />
   453→              </div>
   454→            </div>
   455→            {/* Image grid: 3-column with aspect-square items */}
   456→            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
   457→              <div className="aspect-square bg-muted rounded" />
   458→              <div className="aspect-square bg-muted rounded" />
   459→              <div className="aspect-square bg-muted rounded" />
   460→            </div>
   461→          </div>
   462→        ))}
   463→      </div>
   464→    );
   465→  }
   466→
   467→  // Show error state if there's an error loading shots
   468→  if (shotsError) {
   469→    return (
   470→      <div className="py-8">
   471→        <p className="mb-6 text-red-500">Error loading shots: {shotsError.message}</p>
   472→        {onCreateNewShot && (
   473→          <Button onClick={onCreateNewShot}>New Shot</Button>
   474→        )}
   475→      </div>
   476→    );
   477→  }
   478→
   479→  // Show empty state only when we definitively have no shots
   480→  if (!shots || shots.length === 0) {
   481→    return (
   482→      <div className="py-8">
   483→        <p className="mb-6">No shots available for this project. You can create one using the button below.</p>
   484→        {onCreateNewShot && (
   485→          <Button onClick={onCreateNewShot}>New Shot</Button>
   486→        )}
   487→      </div>
   488→    );
   489→  }
   490→
   491→  // TEMPORARILY DISABLED: Dragging is always disabled (Task 20)
   492→  // To restore: const isDragDisabled = sortMode !== 'ordered' || reorderShotsMutation.isPending;
   493→  const isDragDisabled = true; // Ordered mode & reordering temporarily disabled
   494→
   495→  return (
   496→    <DndContext
   497→      sensors={sensors}
   498→      collisionDetection={closestCenter}
   499→      onDragStart={handleDragStart}
   500→      onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
   501→    >
   502→      <SortableContext 
   503→        items={sortableItems}
   504→        strategy={rectSortingStrategy}
   505→      >
   506→        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 md:gap-x-6 md:gap-y-5 pb-6 md:pb-8 px-4 pt-4 pb-2">
   507→          {/* New Shot Drop Zone - matches collapsed shot card structure for consistent height */}
   508→          {(onGenerationDropForNewShot || onFilesDropForNewShot) && (
   509→            <div
   510→              onDragEnter={handleNewShotDragEnter}
   511→              onDragOver={handleNewShotDragOver}
   512→              onDragLeave={handleNewShotDragLeave}
   513→              onDrop={handleNewShotDrop}
   514→              onClick={isNewShotProcessing ? undefined : onCreateNewShot}
   515→              className={cn(
   516→                'group p-4 border-2 border-dashed rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 flex flex-col self-start relative',
   517→                isNewShotProcessing
   518→                  ? 'border-primary/50 bg-primary/5 cursor-wait'
   519→                  : isNewShotDropTarget 
   520→                    ? 'border-green-500 bg-green-500/10 scale-105 cursor-pointer' 
   521→                    : 'border-border hover:border-[hsl(40,55%,58%)] cursor-pointer'
   522→              )}
   523→            >
   524→              {/* Invisible structure to match shot card height exactly */}
   525→              {/* Header: matches VideoShotDisplay's flex header with h-8 buttons */}
   526→              <div className="h-8 mb-3" aria-hidden="true" />
   527→              {/* Image grid: matches VideoShotDisplay's grid-cols-3 gap-2 with aspect-square items */}
   528→              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2" aria-hidden="true">
   529→                <div className="aspect-square" />
   530→                <div className="aspect-square" />
   531→                <div className="aspect-square" />
   532→              </div>
   533→              
   534→              {/* Centered content overlay */}
   535→              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
   536→                {isNewShotProcessing ? (
   537→                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
   538→                    <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 text-primary animate-spin" />
   539→                    <span className="text-sm font-medium text-primary">
   540→                      Creating shot...
   541→                    </span>
   542→                  </div>
   543→                ) : isNewShotDropTarget ? (
   544→                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
   545→                    <Upload className="h-8 w-8 text-green-500 animate-bounce" />
   546→                    <span className="text-sm font-medium text-green-500">
   547→                      {newShotDropType === 'file' ? 'Drop files to create new shot' : 'Drop to create new shot'}
   548→                    </span>
   549→                  </div>
   550→                ) : (
   551→                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
   552→                    <div className="plus-icon-container flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 border-dashed border-muted-foreground/50 group-hover:border-[hsl(40,55%,58%)] transition-all duration-200 group-hover:bg-[hsl(40,55%,58%,0.15)] group-hover:shadow-[0_0_16px_hsl(40,55%,58%,0.4)]">
   553→                      <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-[hsl(40,55%,58%)] transition-all duration-200" />
   554→                    </div>
   555→                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-center text-sm group-hover:text-[hsl(40,55%,58%)] transition-colors duration-200">
   556→                      Create new shot
   557→                    </p>
   558→                  </div>
   559→                )}
   560→              </div>
   561→            </div>
   562→          )}
   563→          
   564→          {/* Skeleton shot card - appears when creating new shot via drop/modal */}
   565→          {pendingSkeletonShot && (
   566→            <div className="p-4 border rounded-lg bg-card/50 opacity-70 animate-pulse self-start">
   567→              {/* Header skeleton (Video, Pencil, Copy, Trash) */}
   568→              <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-3">
   569→                <div className="h-7 w-32 bg-muted rounded" />
   570→                <div className="flex items-center gap-x-1">
   571→                  <div className="h-8 w-8 bg-muted rounded" />
   572→                  <div className="h-8 w-8 bg-muted rounded" />
   573→                  <div className="h-8 w-8 bg-muted rounded" />
   574→                  <div className="h-8 w-8 bg-muted rounded" />
   575→                </div>
   576→              </div>
   577→              {/* Image grid skeleton */}
   578→              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 relative">
   579→                {pendingSkeletonShot.imageCount > 0 ? (
   580→                  <>
   581→                    {Array.from({ length: Math.min(3, pendingSkeletonShot.imageCount) }).map((_, idx) => (
   582→                      <div
   583→                        key={`skeleton-img-${idx}`}

   601→                    <div className="aspect-square rounded border-2 border-dashed border-border" />
   602→                  </>
   603→                )}
   604→              </div>
   605→            </div>
   606→          )}
   607→          
   608→          {shots.map((shot, index) => {
   609→            return (
   610→              <SortableShotItem
   611→                key={shot.id}
   612→                shot={shot}
   613→                onSelectShot={() => onSelectShot(shot)}
   614→                currentProjectId={currentProjectId}
   615→                isDragDisabled={isDragDisabled}
   616→                disabledReason={sortMode !== 'ordered' ? 'Only available in ordered mode' : undefined}
   617→                shouldLoadImages={true} // Always load images since they're from context
   618→                shotIndex={index}
   619→                projectAspectRatio={currentProject?.aspectRatio}
   620→                isHighlighted={highlightedShotId === shot.id}
   621→                onGenerationDrop={onGenerationDropOnShot}
   622→                onFilesDrop={onFilesDropOnShot}
   623→                initialPendingUploads={shot.id === newlyCreatedShotId ? newlyCreatedShotExpectedImages : 0}
   624→                initialPendingBaselineNonVideoCount={shot.id === newlyCreatedShotId ? newlyCreatedShotBaselineNonVideoCount : undefined}
   625→                onInitialPendingUploadsConsumed={shot.id === newlyCreatedShotId ? () => {
   626→                  setNewlyCreatedShotId(null);
   627→                  setNewlyCreatedShotExpectedImages(0);
   628→                  setNewlyCreatedShotBaselineNonVideoCount(0);
   629→                } : undefined}
   630→                dataTour={index === 0 ? 'first-shot' : undefined}
   631→                finalVideo={finalVideoMap.get(shot.id)}
   632→              />
   633→            );
   634→          })}
   635→        </div>
   636→      </SortableContext>
   637→    </DndContext>
   638→  );
   639→};
   640→
   641→export default ShotListDisplay;

   230→    default:

1→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { useDeleteGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/useGenerationMutations';
     3→import { ConfirmDialog } from '@/shared/components/ConfirmDialog';
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Wraps useDeleteGeneration with a confirmation dialog.
     7→ *
     8→ * Returns `requestDelete(id)` which opens the dialog, and a
     9→ * `DeleteConfirmDialog` component that must be rendered by the caller.
    10→ *
    11→ * Works in both hooks and components:
    12→ * - Hooks: return `requestDelete` and `DeleteConfirmDialog` to the consuming component
    13→ * - Components: call `requestDelete` and render `<DeleteConfirmDialog />` directly
    14→ *
    15→ * @example
    16→ * ```tsx
    17→ * const { requestDelete, DeleteConfirmDialog, isPending } = useDeleteGenerationWithConfirm();
    18→ *
    19→ * return (
    20→ *   <>
    21→ *     <button onClick={() => requestDelete(id)}>Delete</button>
    22→ *     <DeleteConfirmDialog />
    23→ *   </>
    24→ * );
    25→ * ```
    26→ */
    27→export function useDeleteGenerationWithConfirm() {
    28→  const deleteGenerationMutation = useDeleteGeneration();
    29→  const [pendingDeleteId, setPendingDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    30→
    31→  const requestDelete = useCallback((id: string) => {
    32→    setPendingDeleteId(id);
    33→  }, []);
    34→
    35→  const handleConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    36→    if (pendingDeleteId) {
    37→      deleteGenerationMutation.mutate(pendingDeleteId);
    38→      setPendingDeleteId(null);
    39→    }
    40→  }, [pendingDeleteId, deleteGenerationMutation]);
    41→
    42→  const handleOpenChange = useCallback((open: boolean) => {
    43→    if (!open) {
    44→      setPendingDeleteId(null);
    45→    }
    46→  }, []);
    47→
    48→  /** Render this in your component tree to show the confirmation dialog */
    49→  const DeleteConfirmDialog = useCallback(() => (
    50→    <ConfirmDialog
    51→      open={pendingDeleteId !== null}
    52→      onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
    53→      title="Delete Generation"
    54→      description="Are you sure you want to delete this generation? This action cannot be undone."
    55→      confirmText="Delete"
    56→      destructive
    57→      onConfirm={handleConfirm}
    58→    />
    59→  ), [pendingDeleteId, handleOpenChange, handleConfirm]);
    60→
    61→  return {
    62→    /** Opens the confirmation dialog for the given generation ID */
    63→    requestDelete,
    64→    /** Render this component in your JSX tree: `<DeleteConfirmDialog />` */
    65→    DeleteConfirmDialog,
    66→    /** Whether a delete is currently in progress */
    67→    isPending: deleteGenerationMutation.isPending,
    68→    /** The ID currently being deleted (or null) */
    69→    deletingId: deleteGenerationMutation.isPending ? (deleteGenerationMutation.variables as string) : null,
    70→  };
    71→}
    72→

     3→ * =========================================================
     4→ *
     5→ * This is a PAGE-LEVEL CONTROLLER, not a data fetching hook.
     6→ * It manages filter state, pagination, and action handlers for gallery pages.
     7→ *
     8→ * ## When to Use
     9→ * - Building a tool page with the standard GenerationsPane
    10→ * - You need filter state (shot filter, starred, search) with persistence
    11→ * - You need "add to shot" or "delete" action handlers
    12→ * - You want automatic filter persistence per-shot
    13→ *
    14→ * ## When NOT to Use
    15→ * - You just need to fetch generations -> use `useProjectGenerations` directly
    16→ * - You're inside a shot editor -> use hooks from `useShotImages.ts`
    17→ * - You're building a custom gallery without standard filters
    18→ *
    19→ * ## What This Hook Provides
    20→ * - **State**: selectedShotFilter, excludePositioned, searchTerm, starredOnly, page
    21→ * - **Data**: paginatedData, totalCount, expectedItemCount (for skeletons)
    22→ * - **Handlers**: handleAddToShot, handleDeleteGeneration, handleToggleStar
    23→ * - **Loading**: isLoading, isFetching, isError
    24→ *
    25→ * ## Internal Dependencies
    26→ * - Calls `useGalleryFilterState` for filter state management
    27→ * - Calls `useProjectGenerations` for data fetching
    28→ * - Calls `useShots` for shot list and counts
    29→ *
    30→ * @module useGalleryPageState

   160→
   161→    return {

   166→  }, [generationsResponse, page, itemsPerPage]);

### Create-task edge function
- `supabase/functions/create-task/index.ts` — Read FULL file. Check:

1→-- ============================================================================
     2→-- REMOVE APPLICATION_NAME BYPASS FROM CREDIT SYSTEM
     3→-- ============================================================================
     4→-- The prevent_direct_credit_updates trigger was already cleaned up in
     5→-- 20250910220010 to remove the application_name bypass. However,
     6→-- refresh_user_balance still sets application_name as dead code.
     7→--
     8→-- This migration:
     9→-- 1. Cleans up refresh_user_balance to remove vestigial application_name usage
    10→-- 2. Re-asserts the clean trigger definition (defense in depth)
    11→-- ============================================================================
    12→
    13→-- 1. Clean up refresh_user_balance: remove dead application_name set/reset
    14→--    The function has SECURITY DEFINER because it's a trigger on credits_ledger
    15→--    that needs to UPDATE users.credits. The credits_ledger table has RLS
    16→--    restricting writes to service_role, so this trigger always fires in a
    17→--    service_role context, which the credit protection trigger allows.
    18→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION refresh_user_balance()
    19→RETURNS trigger
    20→LANGUAGE plpgsql
    21→SECURITY DEFINER
    22→AS $$
    23→BEGIN
    24→  UPDATE users SET credits = (
    25→    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)
    26→    FROM credits_ledger
    27→    WHERE user_id = COALESCE(NEW.user_id, OLD.user_id)
    28→  ) WHERE id = COALESCE(NEW.user_id, OLD.user_id);
    29→
    30→  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
    31→END;
    32→$$;
    33→
    34→-- 2. Re-assert the clean credit protection trigger (no application_name bypass).
    35→--    This is identical to the version from 20250910220010 but re-stated here
    36→--    as defense in depth: if a migration between then and now somehow
    37→--    reintroduced the bypass, this corrects it.
    38→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prevent_direct_credit_updates()
    39→RETURNS TRIGGER
    40→LANGUAGE plpgsql
    41→AS $$
    42→BEGIN
    43→  -- Allow if called by service role (edge functions using supabaseAdmin,
    44→  -- and SECURITY DEFINER functions triggered from service_role context)
    45→  IF auth.role() = 'service_role' THEN
    46→    RETURN NEW;
    47→  END IF;
    48→
    49→  -- Block direct credit changes from any other role
    50→  IF OLD.credits IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.credits THEN
    51→    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Direct credit updates are not allowed. Use the credits_ledger table.';
    52→  END IF;
    53→
    54→  RETURN NEW;
    55→END;
    56→$$;
    57→

1→-- =====================================================================
     2→-- Auto-fail stale orchestrator tasks stuck "In Progress" for >24 hours
     3→-- Created: 2026-02-13
     4→-- Purpose: Workers may crash, leaving tasks permanently in progress.
     5→--          This cron job auto-fails them hourly so they don't block UIs.
     6→-- =====================================================================
     7→
     8→-- Function to fail stale tasks
     9→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_fail_stale_tasks()
    10→RETURNS INTEGER
    11→LANGUAGE plpgsql
    12→SECURITY DEFINER
    13→AS $$
    14→DECLARE
    15→  affected_count INTEGER;
    16→BEGIN
    17→  UPDATE tasks
    18→  SET
    19→    status = 'Failed'::task_status,
    20→    error_message = 'Auto-failed: stuck in progress for >24 hours',
    21→    updated_at = NOW()
    22→  WHERE status = 'In Progress'::task_status
    23→    AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';
    24→
    25→  GET DIAGNOSTICS affected_count = ROW_COUNT;
    26→
    27→  IF affected_count > 0 THEN
    28→    RAISE NOTICE 'auto_fail_stale_tasks: failed % stale task(s)', affected_count;
    29→  END IF;
    30→
    31→  RETURN affected_count;
    32→END;
    33→$$;
    34→
    35→-- Schedule hourly via pg_cron (extension already enabled in earlier migration)
    36→SELECT cron.schedule(
    37→  'auto-fail-stale-tasks',
    38→  '0 * * * *',
    39→  $$SELECT auto_fail_stale_tasks();$$
    40→);
    41→
    42→-- Verify
    43→SELECT 'auto-fail-stale-tasks cron job scheduled' AS status;
    44→

1→-- =====================================================================
     2→-- Schedule daily verify_shot_sync() check via pg_cron
     3→-- Created: 2026-02-13
     4→-- Purpose: verify_shot_sync() detects mismatches between denormalized
     5→--          shot data on generations and the source-of-truth
     6→--          shot_generations table. Running it daily catches any sync
     7→--          drift before it becomes a user-visible problem.
     8→-- Risk: Read-only monitoring — no writes to application tables.
     9→-- =====================================================================
    10→
    11→-- Wrapper that calls verify_shot_sync() and raises warnings for any
    12→-- mismatches found. pg_cron captures RAISE output in
    13→-- cron.job_run_details, making results queryable after each run.
    14→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.run_shot_sync_check()
    15→RETURNS INTEGER
    16→LANGUAGE plpgsql
    17→SECURITY DEFINER
    18→AS $$
    19→DECLARE
    20→  mismatch_count INTEGER;
    21→  rec RECORD;
    22→BEGIN
    23→  -- Count mismatches first (cheap — avoids cursor overhead when clean)
    24→  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO mismatch_count FROM verify_shot_sync();
    25→
    26→  IF mismatch_count = 0 THEN
    27→    RAISE NOTICE 'shot_sync_check: all generations in sync';
    28→    RETURN 0;
    29→  END IF;
    30→
    31→  -- Log each mismatch so it appears in Postgres logs / job_run_details
    32→  RAISE WARNING 'shot_sync_check: found % mismatch(es)', mismatch_count;
    33→
    34→  FOR rec IN SELECT * FROM verify_shot_sync() LOOP
    35→    RAISE WARNING 'shot_sync_check mismatch: generation=%, gen_shot=%, sg_shot=%, gen_frame=%, sg_frame=%, status=%',
    36→      rec.generation_id, rec.gen_shot_id, rec.sg_shot_id,
    37→      rec.gen_frame, rec.sg_frame, rec.status;
    38→  END LOOP;
    39→
    40→  RETURN mismatch_count;
    41→END;
    42→$$;
    43→
    44→COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.run_shot_sync_check IS
    45→'Wrapper around verify_shot_sync() for pg_cron. Returns mismatch count and logs details via RAISE WARNING.';
    46→
    47→-- Schedule daily at 3 AM UTC (pg_cron extension already enabled)
    48→SELECT cron.schedule(
    49→  'daily-shot-sync-check',
    50→  '0 3 * * *',
    51→  $$SELECT run_shot_sync_check();$$
    52→);
    53→
    54→SELECT 'daily-shot-sync-check cron job scheduled' AS status;
    55→
